###### Purpose

To produce value for every person, organization, and community we are associated with, live, and
work in. Our customers, suppliers, company, and community.

###### Mission

To produce value by providing metal products and services that are market leaders in quality,
customer satisfaction, and cost through the integration of people, technology, business systems, and
our values.

###### Vision

To become and sustain Integrated Metal Products as the leader in our market. Leading and making a
positive impact in all aspects; as a company, in the community, in the economy, and in the lives of
individuals and families.

## Meet Our Team

Our Integrated Metal Products team is ready to serve your modular & mobile product needs & beyond!

To produce value by providing metal products and services that are market leaders in quality,
customer satisfaction, and cost through the integration of people, technology, business systems, and
our values.

###### Vision

To become and sustain Integrated Metal Products as the leader in our market. Leading and making a
positive impact in all aspects; as a company, in the community, in the economy, and in the lives of
individuals and families.

## Your “Go-To” Design-Build Contractor 

A.C.E. Building Service offers commercial and industrial construction services to owners and
facility managers in Manitowoc, Sheboygan and the Lakeshore area.

At A.C.E., our reputation is our foundation…a reputation that started in Wisconsin in 1963 and has
continued to flourish throughout the years.

Our customers will attest to the fact that our ability to listen carefully to their needs has kept
them coming back to A.C.E. as their preferred general contractor. Integrity, trust, fairness,

# Get to Know the People Behind A.C.E.

[[Meet the Team]][64]

### Project Awards

### **Dakota Supply Group (DSG)**

Dakota Supply Group is one of the Midwest’s largest employee-owned distributors of electrical,
plumbing, HVAC, and utility products. DSG partnered with local development group High Tech
Investments, who contacted with A.C.E. Building Service to construct this new 40,000-square-foot
facility in Sheboygan, Wisconsin.

This new distribution center replaced an outdated downtown facility that struggled with
accessibility, segmented layouts, and limited capacity. The state-of-the-art Butler Landmark
building system provides expansive warehouse space, dedicated office areas, a screened exterior bulk
storage yard, and client-facing demonstration areas.

### **HTT Inc.**

HTT Inc partnered with A.C.E. Building Service, a leading precision metal stamping company serving
the automotive, agriculture, and construction industries, to deliver a 32,075-square-foot expansion
of their Sheboygan manufacturing facility.

The project was far from a typical addition. Before construction could begin, a city street and
seven major utilities (including water, sewer, natural gas, high-voltage transmission, and fiber
optic) had to be vacated or relocated. This required months of coordination with the City of
Sheboygan, local utility providers, and private service companies.

### **Wisconsin Aluminum Foundry (WAF)**

Wisconsin Aluminum Foundry, a Manitowoc institution since 1909, has produced specialty castings and
consumer products for over a century. By 2023, however, the company’s office spaces, many carved
from areas never intended for that purpose, were undersized, outdated, and no longer reflective of
WAF’s industry stature.

### Project Awards

### **Dakota Supply Group (DSG)**

Dakota Supply Group is one of the Midwest’s largest employee-owned distributors of electrical,
plumbing, HVAC, and utility products. DSG partnered with local development group High Tech
Investments, who contacted with A.C.E. Building Service to construct this new 40,000-square-foot
facility in Sheboygan, Wisconsin.

This new distribution center replaced an outdated downtown facility that struggled with
accessibility, segmented layouts, and limited capacity. The state-of-the-art Butler Landmark
building system provides expansive warehouse space, dedicated office areas, a screened exterior bulk
storage yard, and client-facing demonstration areas.

### **HTT Inc.**

HTT Inc partnered with A.C.E. Building Service, a leading precision metal stamping company serving
the automotive, agriculture, and construction industries, to deliver a 32,075-square-foot expansion
of their Sheboygan manufacturing facility.

The project was far from a typical addition. Before construction could begin, a city street and
seven major utilities (including water, sewer, natural gas, high-voltage transmission, and fiber
optic) had to be vacated or relocated. This required months of coordination with the City of
Sheboygan, local utility providers, and private service companies.

### **Wisconsin Aluminum Foundry (WAF)**

Wisconsin Aluminum Foundry, a Manitowoc institution since 1909, has produced specialty castings and
consumer products for over a century. By 2023, however, the company’s office spaces, many carved
from areas never intended for that purpose, were undersized, outdated, and no longer reflective of
WAF’s industry stature.

Partnering with Somerville Architects & Engineers and A.C.E. Building Service, WAF undertook a
complete renovation and expansion, reclaiming former storage areas and delivering 14,000 square feet
of modern, efficient office space. The phased construction plan minimized disruption to foundry
operations while ensuring staff had seamless transitions between workspaces.

### **Kaysun**

As a Design/Build general contractor, A.C.E. Building Service was happy to design and construct a
54,000-square-foot addition to Kaysun Corporation’s injection molding manufacturing facility.
Collaborating closely with Kaysun stakeholders, we implemented Butler Manufacturing’s metal building
solutions, including a unique metal re-roof system and infrastructure upgrades, to maximize future
growth potential and enhance operational efficiency.

### **Dramm**

A.C.E. Building Service collaborated with Abacus Architects to create a 98,735-square-foot facility
for Dramm Corporation. The project, designed to improve process flow and consolidate operations, was
completed in three phases. The first phase included the construction of a steel pre-engineered
manufacturing and warehouse building, the second consisted of a conventional steel structure for
corporate offices, and the third was the construction of a greenhouse for research and design.
Despite severe supply chain challenges, A.C.E. Building Service completed each phase within seven
months, incorporating sustainable features like a solar array, green building design practices, and
materials containing high amounts of pre and post-consumer recycled content to ensure efficiency and
future growth.

### **PetSkull Brewing**

A.C.E. Building Service transformed a long-vacant 113-year-old building in historic downtown
Manitowoc into PetSkull Brewing's brewery and taproom. The renovation included the preservation of
the building's historic charm while updating it to meet the client’s needs and adhere to modern code
requirements. Exterior work included structural reinforcement, restoration of the original cream
city brick, and the construction of a new outdoor patio. Inside, original elements were preserved
and integrated with modern HVAC and fire protection systems. The project, which took over a year of
planning, utilized several grant programs, successfully blended original building charm and modern
amenities, resulting in a unique space for craft beer enthusiasts.

# Metal Stamping Manufacturer for Precision Sheet Metal Fabrication and OEM Solutions

## Your Trusted Metal Stamping Partner for Global Manufacturing

In today’s competitive manufacturing landscape, choosing the right metal stamping manufacturer is
critical to achieving product quality, cost efficiency, and production stability.
At AOTRON, we specialize in metal stamping, delivering high-precision metal stamping parts for
industries such as electronics, automotive, industrial equipment, and structural hardware.
With over 40 years of experience in sheet metal stamping, stamping die design, and custom metal
stamping, we support global OEM and ODM projects from concept to mass production.
[ CONTACT US ][77]
[ Profile Slides ][78]
[stamping die-AOTRON]

## What Is Metal Stamping?

Metal stamping is a manufacturing process that transforms flat metal sheets into functional parts
using a stamping press, stamping tooling, and stamping dies.
This process includes:
* **sheet metal forming**
* **sheet metal cutting**
* **deep drawing**
* **progressive stamping**
It is widely used in high volume metal stamping production due to its speed, precision, and cost
efficiency.
[progressive stamping die system-AOTRON]
[ Contact Us ][79]

## AOTRON Metal Stamping Services

## 43 years of professional experience, industry-leading technology, customized design, high-quality
## professional control

Since its establishment in 1983, AOTRON Industry has accumulated 43 years of professional metal
stamping technology and experience, and has become an industry leader with excellent reputation and
performance.
Based on innovation and expertise, we develop exclusive technologies to meet the needs of
high-precision, high-performance products. Provide customized mold design and tailor-made solutions,
which are widely used in multiple industries.
At the same time, we adhere to high-quality process management, from raw material inspection to
process monitoring, to ensure that products meet international standards and are stable and
reliable. We are committed to becoming a long-term partner of our customers to create market value
and growth.
[OEM metal stamping manufacturer-AOTRON]

## Advanced Stamping Process & Equipment

Our production is powered by advanced stamping press systems and precision stamping tooling.
We utilize:
* High-speed **press stamping machines**
* Precision **sheet metal press**
* Advanced **deep drawing process**
* Multi-stage **progressive stamping systems**
This ensures high efficiency in sheet metal fabrication and stable production quality.

## Your Trusted Metal Stamping Partner for Global Manufacturing

In today’s competitive manufacturing landscape, choosing the right metal stamping manufacturer is
critical to achieving product quality, cost efficiency, and production stability.
At AOTRON, we specialize in metal stamping, delivering high-precision metal stamping parts for
industries such as electronics, automotive, industrial equipment, and structural hardware.
With over 40 years of experience in sheet metal stamping, stamping die design, and custom metal
stamping, we support global OEM and ODM projects from concept to mass production.

## What Is Metal Stamping?

Metal stamping is a manufacturing process that transforms flat metal sheets into functional parts
using a stamping press, stamping tooling, and stamping dies.
This process includes:
* **sheet metal forming**
* **sheet metal cutting**
* **deep drawing**
* **progressive stamping**
It is widely used in high volume metal stamping production due to its speed, precision, and cost
efficiency.

## Strength, Precision, and Quality in Steel Fabrication & Distribution

[ Request Pricing ][407]
[ Browse Catalogs ][408]

Your Trusted Steel Supplier

## A Half-Century Journey of Excellence

Over the last 50+ years, the DeFaria family has dedicated themselves to our goals, shaping Allied
Steel into the number one steel supplier in New Jersey, New York, and New York City. As a highly
competitive steel and metal fabricator, we prioritize quality and customer service to ensure each
order is completed to our highest standards of satisfaction. Our [Express Prime Delivery][409]
assures prompt on-time delivery of your steel and metal orders.

## Metal Products

Explore our extensive range of high-quality steel and metal products, including aluminum, stainless
steel, sheet metal, and more, tailored for both commercial and residential projects.

### Mild Steel

[View Mild Steel Products][410]

### Aluminum

[View Aluminum Products][411]

### Stainless Steel

[View Stainless Steel Products][412]

## Our Services

Our team of professionals provide a wide array of steel fabrication services in our state-of-the-art
facility.

#### Welding

Providing high-quality and reliable steel welding services.

[More][413]

#### Bending & Forming

Shaping sheet metal and steel plates into desired angles and forms.

[More][414]

#### Plasma Cutting

Thermal cutting process, using high temperature arc to cut various metals.

[More][415]

#### Saw Cutting

Precision cutting for both simple and complex structural steel shapes

[More][416]

#### Plate Burning

Oxygen and acetylene flame cutting, ideal for thicker materials.

[More][417]

[ See All Services ][418]

## Steel at Your Speed — Delivered to the Minute

Experience our [Express Prime Delivery][419] — fast, reliable, and tailored to meet your tight
delivery windows and deadlines. We distribute a vast array of steel and metal products directly to
your project site, ensuring you get what you need, when you need it.

## Decades of Trust, From Prototype to Production

Clamason are internationally recognised precision pressing and stamping experts, empowering OEMs
around the globe to produce industry-leading technology.

At Clamason, we help industry leaders to innovate and develop through exceptionally manufactured
components. To achieve this, we partner with global customers to support projects of all sizes, from
prototype to production. Using our many years of design and metal pressing engineering experience,
our engineers are extremely creative during the product design engineering process, always looking
for opportunities to deliver added value and cost savings for our clients across all our target
sectors.

produce precision tooling quickly, efficiently and with minimal waste.

# Precision Metal Stamping and Presswork

A market leader for over 75 years, Clamason is your full-service partner for the development and
manufacture of precision pressings

## Decades of Trust, From Prototype to Production

Clamason are internationally recognised precision pressing and stamping experts, empowering OEMs
around the globe to produce industry-leading technology.

 

 

SERVICES WE OFFER

## PRECISION UNDERPINNED BY EXPERT PRODUCTION

At Clamason, we help industry leaders to innovate and develop through exceptionally manufactured
components. To achieve this, we partner with global customers to support projects of all sizes, from
prototype to production. Using our many years of design and metal pressing engineering experience,
our engineers are extremely creative during the product design engineering process, always looking
for opportunities to deliver added value and cost savings for our clients across all our target
sectors.

### WHY PARTNER WITH CLAMASON?

Our engineers work with your team from early in the design phase, using advanced technology to
produce precision tooling quickly, efficiently and with minimal waste.

We’re [ISO9001][69], [ISO13485][70], [ISO14001][71] and [IATF16949][72] accredited, giving you the
assurance that our knowledge and quality of process will match the specialist needs of your devices.

Clamason also has extensive metallurgy experience, for example, with the unique properties of metals
such as stainless steel. This enables us to make highly effective and low-risk decisions in regard
to the design and manufacture of your product. We also understand how to best [clean, handle and
package][73] precision metal stampings. In short, a single, turnkey solution for the entire
production cycle of your component. 

[Ready to find out more?][74]

# Modern Metalworks, Built to Perform

Full-Service Metal Stamping and Fabrication

Clow delivers full-service metal stamping and fabrication solutions for OEMs that expect quality
without compromise. From powersports to heavy equipment, our team blends advanced metal fabrication
technology with the craftsmanship and care of a trusted partner.

[A factory worker in overalls and gloves operates a large industrial machine press in a dimly lit

and cleaning supplies.]

## A proven supplier to recognized OEMs

What began as a family business has grown into one of the nation’s largest and most respected
stamping and fabrication facilities. Our 390,000-square-foot Minnesota plant is equipped for
projects of every scale, giving customers access to reliable capacity, technical expertise, and
short lead times.

Clow brings together a full suite of manufacturing services to keep production precise and
efficient. Each service is part of an integrated workflow designed around accuracy and
accountability.

relationship development with manufacturers have made us a trusted sourcing expert for a variety of
precision metal components.

## Devchhaya Group Of Industries

##### Leading Sheet Metal Presses Components Provider Since 1990

Welcome to Devchhaya Group Of Industries! We are a leading manufacturer, exporter, and supplier of a
wide range of high-quality Sheet metal stampings and assemblies, Sheet metal pressed parts and
assemblies, Sheet metal automotive components, sheet metal Pressing, stampings, welding and
fabrication components press tools, press components, Steel stampings, pressing , fabrication and
tubular components, Engineering metal stampings, fabrication and tubular assemblies in Pune,
Maharashtra, India.
The company was established in the year 1990 and initially started as a job worker of sheet shearing
for Tata Motor's vendors with a single shearing machine. Over the years, Devchhaya Industries has
grown to become a major vendor for some of the world's most recognized and India's largest
automobile companies, including Tata Motors. The company currently has a strength of 440+ employees
and is a group company of 5 major units, equipped with advanced manufacturing machinery and
infrastructure.
[Read More][43]

#### ▶ PUNE PLANT (Unit-2)

##### Announcement

We are proud to announce a major milestone in the journey of Devchhaya Industries—the establishment
of a new manufacturing plant as part of our strategic expansion plan. This development reaffirms our
commitment to innovation, capacity growth, and serving the Indian automobile and fabrication sectors
with unmatched quality and reliability.
Our new plant is expected to be ready by this year end.

###### Facilities at our new plant:
* We are adding 250 ton, 350 ton and 500 ton presses (one each)
* Laser cutting machine 1500×3000 6KW
* Press brake (CNC)
* Welding machines
* Other auxiliary machine and facilities

Welcome To

## Devchhaya Group Of Industries

##### Leading Sheet Metal Presses Components Provider Since 1990

Welcome to Devchhaya Group Of Industries! We are a leading manufacturer, exporter, and supplier of a
wide range of high-quality Sheet metal stampings and assemblies, Sheet metal pressed parts and
assemblies, Sheet metal automotive components, sheet metal Pressing, stampings, welding and
fabrication components press tools, press components, Steel stampings, pressing , fabrication and
tubular components, Engineering metal stampings, fabrication and tubular assemblies in Pune,
Maharashtra, India.
The company was established in the year 1990 and initially started as a job worker of sheet shearing
for Tata Motor's vendors with a single shearing machine. Over the years, Devchhaya Industries has
grown to become a major vendor for some of the world's most recognized and India's largest
automobile companies, including Tata Motors. The company currently has a strength of 440+ employees
and is a group company of 5 major units, equipped with advanced manufacturing machinery and
infrastructure.
[Read More][43]

#### ▶ PUNE PLANT (Unit-2)

##### Announcement

We are proud to announce a major milestone in the journey of Devchhaya Industries—the establishment
of a new manufacturing plant as part of our strategic expansion plan. This development reaffirms our
commitment to innovation, capacity growth, and serving the Indian automobile and fabrication sectors
with unmatched quality and reliability.
Our new plant is expected to be ready by this year end.

###### Facilities at our new plant:
* We are adding 250 ton, 350 ton and 500 ton presses (one each)
* Laser cutting machine 1500×3000 6KW
* Press brake (CNC)
* Welding machines
* Other auxiliary machine and facilities

# Custom Metal Stamping Solutions for Your Most Complex Needs

When you require the production of precision metal parts and assemblies, we're the custom metal
stamping manufacturer you can turn to for excellence. Every time. 

[ Contact Us ][23]
[ Meet Falls Stamping & Welding ][24]

## Metal Forming, Redefined

For more than a century, the metal-forming experts at Falls Stamping & Welding have met the dynamic
needs of our customers, building long-lasting relationships through a commitment to precision,
quality, and service. We specialize in short- and long-run metal stamping and fabrication, and
assemblies, delivering [solutions that go beyond the capabilities of traditional manufacturers][25].

Everything we produce is proudly made in the USA, with a focus on precision and quality across a
range of materials, including.
* Stainless steel
* Hot and cold rolled steel
* Aluminum
* Galvanized metal

We also supply stainless and carbon steel exhaust and tank straps to the heavy-duty truck and
automotive sector. We can do this because we excel at manufacturing complex stampings and assemblies
that don’t lend themselves to automation due to design and volume constraints.

[ Contact Us ][26]
[metal stamped parts ]

## Our Core Services

Our presses, ranging from 100 to 900 tons, enable us to produce a wide variety of parts, from
intricate components to larger assemblies. We're also IATF 16949:2016 and ISO 14001:2015 certified
to work in many industries. 

[fabricated metal products]

#### Metal Stamping

We specialize in custom, complex metal stampings that others find challenging, including those that
defy automation and require high touch.

[Metal Stamping][27]
[metal fabricated piece]

#### Production Metal Fabrication

Our position as a Tier 1 fabricator and OEM supplier speaks to our extensive experience. We thrive
in tackling tight tolerances, complex geometries and challenging projects.

[Production Metal Fabrication][28]
[strap assembly services]

#### Strap Assembly Services

Our proprietary strap line allows us to manufacture a diverse range of straps for fuel tanks, air
tanks, and more.

[Strap Assembly Services][29]
[ISO 14001 Certified Company]
[IATF 16949 Certified Company]

## How You Benefit From a Falls Stamping & Welding Partnership

When you partner with us, you experience the Falls Stamping & Welding advantage, where precision
meets proficiency, and innovation transforms your metal solutions.

[close up of a metallic part]

### You Gain Access to Niche Expertise

We excel in orbital riveting and install millions of rivets annually. We also specialize in line-die
stamping, fuel and exhaust strap production and design consultation, as well as laser and
fabrication production. 

****

** [ Explore Our Services ][30] **
[black metal stamped part]

### You Gain Access
### to a Dedicated Team 

Our employees fulfill roles across diverse departments – stamping, assembly, welding assembly,
production fabrication and the strap production line – and intentionally collaborate throughout the
production day. This ensures efficient scheduling and delivery of your parts and assemblies. We
listen to understand your part’s use and function, then work together to improve quality and reduce
costs.

[assortment of metallic parts]

### You Realize Efficiencies & Cost Savings

Our customer-first approach focuses on listening, understanding, and continuous improvement to
enhance both quality and cost-effectiveness. Long-term supply chain partnerships also help us stay
cost-competitive—from raw materials to secondary processes like surface treatments.

Let’s Get to Work

## Find the Right Custom Metal Stamping Solutions for Your Next Project

Partner with a leader in custom metal stamping to bring precision, efficiency and reliability to
every phase of your project.

[ Contact Us ][31]

# Custom Metal Stamping Solutions for Your Most Complex Needs

stamping manufacturer you can turn to for excellence. Every time. 

[ Contact Us ][23]
[ Meet Falls Stamping & Welding ][24]

## Metal Forming, Redefined

For more than a century, the metal-forming experts at Falls Stamping & Welding have met the dynamic
needs of our customers, building long-lasting relationships through a commitment to precision,
quality, and service. We specialize in short- and long-run metal stamping and fabrication, and
assemblies, delivering [solutions that go beyond the capabilities of traditional manufacturers][25].

Everything we produce is proudly made in the USA, with a focus on precision and quality across a
range of materials, including.
* Stainless steel
* Hot and cold rolled steel
* Aluminum
* Galvanized metal

We also supply stainless and carbon steel exhaust and tank straps to the heavy-duty truck and
automotive sector. We can do this because we excel at manufacturing complex stampings and assemblies
that don’t lend themselves to automation due to design and volume constraints.

[ Contact Us ][26]

intricate components to larger assemblies. We're also IATF 16949:2016 and ISO 14001:2015 certified
to work in many industries.

defy automation and require high touch.

Le Groupe Filame

## Fiabilité et expertise depuis 1999

Avec plus de 50 collaborateurs et un programme d’investissement soutenu, Filame est un leader
technologique sur le marché des ressorts et des pièces embouties. Nous produisons plus de 500
millions de pièces par an pour des leaders mondiaux dans divers secteurs industriels.

[À propos du groupe][121]

Expertise Sectorielle

## Une présence forte dans les industries clés

Le Groupe Filame travaille de l’unité à la grande série pour l’industrie en général, avec un savoir
faire spécifique dans plusieurs industries clés. Le top 10 de nos clients est composé de leaders
mondiaux ou européens dans leurs domaines.

Matières & Finitions

## Maîtrise des alliages haute performance

Filame travaille une vaste gamme de métaux, des aciers ressorts classiques aux alliages les plus
complexes comme l’Inconel, l’Hastelloy ou l’Elgiloy. Nous assurons également des traitements de
surface techniques répondant aux normes industrielles les plus strictes.

[Découvrir nos matières][123]

Innovation & Infrastructure

## Machines, automatisation et énergie verte

Filame investit en continu dans des machines CNC suisses, allemandes, italiennes et japonaises.
Grâce à une automatisation poussée — 250 machines opérées par 35 ouvriers — et à ses propres
panneaux solaires, Filame vise l’autonomie énergétique complète.

[Découvrir notre technologie][124]
[Innovation Technologique]

### Le fonds européen de développement régional et la Wallonie investissent dans votre avenir

Filame Brussels a sollicité de la Région Wallonne l’obtention d’une prime à l’investissement dans le
cadre d’un programme d’investissements: la construction d’un hall de production de 3500 M2, achat
d’une machine électroérosion, achats de matériel d’exploitation générant un accroissement d’emploi
nouveau.

Le Groupe Filame

## Fiabilité et expertise depuis 1999

Avec plus de 50 collaborateurs et un programme d’investissement soutenu, Filame est un leader
technologique sur le marché des ressorts et des pièces embouties. Nous produisons plus de 500
millions de pièces par an pour des leaders mondiaux dans divers secteurs industriels.

[À propos du groupe][121]

Expertise Sectorielle

## Une présence forte dans les industries clés

Le Groupe Filame travaille de l’unité à la grande série pour l’industrie en général, avec un savoir
faire spécifique dans plusieurs industries clés. Le top 10 de nos clients est composé de leaders
mondiaux ou européens dans leurs domaines.

Matières & Finitions

## Maîtrise des alliages haute performance

Filame travaille une vaste gamme de métaux, des aciers ressorts classiques aux alliages les plus
complexes comme l’Inconel, l’Hastelloy ou l’Elgiloy. Nous assurons également des traitements de
surface techniques répondant aux normes industrielles les plus strictes.

[Découvrir nos matières][123]

Innovation & Infrastructure

## Machines, automatisation et énergie verte

Filame investit en continu dans des machines CNC suisses, allemandes, italiennes et japonaises.
Grâce à une automatisation poussée — 250 machines opérées par 35 ouvriers — et à ses propres
panneaux solaires, Filame vise l’autonomie énergétique complète.

[Découvrir notre technologie][124]

### Le fonds européen de développement régional et la Wallonie investissent dans votre avenir

Filame Brussels a sollicité de la Région Wallonne l’obtention d’une prime à l’investissement dans le
cadre d’un programme d’investissements: la construction d’un hall de production de 3500 M2, achat
d’une machine électroérosion, achats de matériel d’exploitation générant un accroissement d’emploi
nouveau.

# Manufacturing Innovative Engineered Stamping Products

Freeway Corporation has been a leading manufacturer of washers, metal stampings, driveline
components, assemblies, and machined components for over 80 years. Customers in a diverse array of
industries take advantage of our expertise to fill their needs. Our ASQ/ANSI/ISO 9001:2015 and IATF
16949:2016 certifications validate our commitment to excellence.
* At Freeway, it’s the people that make the difference! We are family-owned and operated and have
  continuously been in business since 1944.
  [Contact Us][52]
  Previous Slide Next Slide
* Freeway has an 12,000 sq ft. Tool Shop that rivals most stand-alone companies. We design,
  engineer, and build all tooling in-house!
  [Contact Us][53]
  Previous Slide Next Slide
* Freeway’s Engineering Team works closely with our customers to find the optimal solution for their
  application(s) in a cost effective manner.
  [Contact Us][54]
  Previous Slide Next Slide
* We have made our name through exceptional quality, on-time delivery, and outstanding customer
  service.
  [Contact Us][55]
  Previous Slide Next Slide

With **production facilities in the United States and Canada,** Freeway Corporation continues to
deliver quality products and innovative solutions to industries worldwide.


## Stamping and Machine Products

Freeway Corporation, headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio, is a dynamic company dedicated to providing
innovative solutions in the metalworking industry. With a commitment to excellence and customer
satisfaction, we strive to exceed expectations in every aspect of our operations. Our team is
comprised of experienced professionals who are passionate about delivering high-quality products and
services, and building lasting relationships with our clients.
[View Stamping Products][56]
[ [Stamped Metal Washers] Metal Washers ][57] [ [Custom metal stamped parts] Metal Stampings ][58] [
[Manufactured driveline parts] Driveline Assembly Components ][59] [ [Prototype machining services]
Machined Components ][60] [ [Commercial grade bearing] Commercial-Grade Bearings ][61]

## METALFORMING MANUFACTURING CAPABILITIES

Explore our comprehensive manufacturing capabilities designed to deliver value-added solutions that
reduce your costs, streamline production, and give you a competitive edge.

[ Metal Stamping Freeway Corporation specializes in high-quality metal stamping services, using
advanced technology to produce complex progressive die stampings, washers, and other formed
components. Our metal stamping capability ensures tight tolerances and controlled processes, making
us a trusted partner for automotive, industrial, and commercial manufacturers. Choose Freeway for
cost-effective metal stamping solutions tailored to your specifications. ][62]
[ Turned Components Our expertise in turned components allows us to deliver custom-machined parts on
time and to print. Utilizing state-of-the-art CNC turning equipment, Freeway Corporation
manufactures precision turned components for the most demanding industries. Rely on our turned
component capabilities when tolerances are tight and value matters. ][63]
[ Assemblies & Kitting Freeway Corporation’s assemblies and kitting services streamline your
production process by delivering ready-to-use, fully assembled and packaged component kits. We
manage the most complex assembly and kitting projects with efficiency and attention to detail,
reducing your overhead and improving supply chain efficiency. Count on our assemblies and kitting
expertise to optimize your operations and ensure timely, reliable delivery. ][64]
[View all Industries][65]

## About freeway cor

## About Us

### Company Overview

Founded in 1967 and located in the Northwest Suburbs of Chicago, G&M Manufacturing Corporation is a
testament to the metal stamping industry by providing products with quality and reliability that can
withstand the test of time.

We are proud to be a stable, long-term supplier with a loyal, non-unionized workforce. Because of
our extensive experience processing various types of materials, we are able to meet our customers’
complex needs with precision and efficiency, ensuring perfect results in every project.

### Mission and Vision

At G&M, our mission is to achieve the highest possible level of customer satisfaction through
designing and implementing manufacturing processes that meet the highest quality and output. We
strive to become the leading metal stamping manufacturer and offerers of custom precision metal
stamping, continually improving our processes to minimize long-term costs and maximize performance.
We are dedicated to innovation and excellence, making us your ideal partner for high-quality metal
components.

Our Services

## Precision Metal Stamping at G&M

With presses of up to 100 tons in an ISO 9001:2015-certified facility, G&M Manufacturing ensures
precision in all its precision metal stamping. Many of our presses are equipped with in-die sensors
and automated camera systems to ensure the best standard of quality. We work with a variety of
materials, including copper alloys, stainless steel, high and low-carbon steels, aluminum, and many
clad materials.

Our stampings range from intricate lead frames and springs to connectors and brackets, all meeting
the stringent demands of industries like automotive, electronics, and medical. Thanks to our
expertise, we can handle complex product shapes and patterns, providing consistently reliable parts
for any application.

[Learn more][37]
 
Our Services

## Busbar Manufacturing

At G&M, a core area of our business is the production of high-quality busbars—an indispensable
component for effective energy distribution in many electrical applications. Our capability in
precision metal stamping makes it possible for us to be excellent busbar manufacturers.

Our busbars are designed with aluminum and copper, both known for their conductive nature and
performance within electrical systems. We also plate them in tin, silver, or nickel to improve their
durability and corrosion resistance. In any case, our products provide optimal safety and efficiency
when it comes to delivering power to vehicles, switch gears, and electronic devices. Choosing G&M as
your busbar manufacturer is a guarantee that you will benefit from our industry expertise, our
commitment to quality, and our capability to provide precise tailored solutions that meet the needs
of your operations.

[Learn more][38]

## Featured Stamping Projects

At G&M Manufacturing, we handle a broad spectrum of stamping projects, demonstrating our versatility
across multiple industries. From intricate automotive components to robust industrial machinery
parts, our custom precision metal stamping and busbar manufacturing capabilities enable us to tackle
challenges and deliver precision-engineered solutions.

### Our Outstanding Projects

One notable project involved reengineering a steel gear housing for the timing motor industry,
enhancing the design to meet stringent specifications. Using our 100-ton Minster press, we combined
two parts into one, streamlining the process and ensuring tolerances as tight as ±.001″. This
project demonstrates our ability to optimize designs for functionality and cost-effectiveness while
maintaining the highest quality standards.

Another significant achievement was producing over 1.2 million brass housings annually for
automotive throttle position sensors. Utilizing our high-speed presses, we maintained exacting
tolerances of ±.0005″, exemplifying our precision in manufacturing complex components for critical
applications.

For the copier industry, we stamped a unique brass cover that required intricate forming and a slot
stamped with a cam in the progressive die, saving additional steps and costs. Manufactured with our
80-ton Johnson press, this part highlighted our skill in handling difficult draws and combining
operations for efficiency. The brass cover, with its barrel nickel plating over copper flash, met
tight tolerances of ±.003″ and was produced at a volume of 60,000 annually.

In the exercise equipment industry, we designed and stamped a stainless steel electrode and terminal
in one step, eliminating a secondary manufacturing process and adding a cost-saving that was passed
on to the customer. The part measured 4″ long, 0.9″ wide, and 0.7″ high, and was manufactured using
our 60-ton Minster press. This project showcases our ability to produce geometrically challenging
parts and minimize costs, with a production volume of 15,000 electrodes annually and a tight
tolerance of ±.002″.

Lastly, for the automotive industry, we produced a blade power terminal used in a power circuit for
an interconnect header. This part was stamped using our high-speed, 60-ton Bruderer press, achieving
dimensions of 49 mm by 22 mm with a precise tolerance of ±.025 mm. Made from high-performance C14415
copper with a reflow tin over copper flash finish, this project underscores our proficiency in
delivering high-quality components for automotive applications, with an annual volume of 1,550,000
blade terminals.

Explore our featured stamping projects to learn more about our advanced manufacturing processes, the
wide range of materials we work with, and how we tailor our solutions to meet the specific needs of
industries, including automotive, electronics, medical, and more.

 


## Why Choose G&M?

### Industry Expertise

G&M Manufacturing is recognized for its vast experience within various industries, from automotive
and industrial to electronics and medical. Our vast industry knowledge has made it possible for us

### Our Outstanding Projects

One notable project involved reengineering a steel gear housing for the timing motor industry,
enhancing the design to meet stringent specifications. Using our 100-ton Minster press, we combined
two parts into one, streamlining the process and ensuring tolerances as tight as ±.001″. This
project demonstrates our ability to optimize designs for functionality and cost-effectiveness while
maintaining the highest quality standards.

Another significant achievement was producing over 1.2 million brass housings annually for
automotive throttle position sensors. Utilizing our high-speed presses, we maintained exacting
tolerances of ±.0005″, exemplifying our precision in manufacturing complex components for critical
applications.

For the copier industry, we stamped a unique brass cover that required intricate forming and a slot
stamped with a cam in the progressive die, saving additional steps and costs. Manufactured with our
80-ton Johnson press, this part highlighted our skill in handling difficult draws and combining
operations for efficiency. The brass cover, with its barrel nickel plating over copper flash, met
tight tolerances of ±.003″ and was produced at a volume of 60,000 annually.

In the exercise equipment industry, we designed and stamped a stainless steel electrode and terminal
in one step, eliminating a secondary manufacturing process and adding a cost-saving that was passed
on to the customer. The part measured 4″ long, 0.9″ wide, and 0.7″ high, and was manufactured using
our 60-ton Minster press. This project showcases our ability to produce geometrically challenging
parts and minimize costs, with a production volume of 15,000 electrodes annually and a tight
tolerance of ±.002″.

Lastly, for the automotive industry, we produced a blade power terminal used in a power circuit for
an interconnect header. This part was stamped using our high-speed, 60-ton Bruderer press, achieving
dimensions of 49 mm by 22 mm with a precise tolerance of ±.025 mm. Made from high-performance C14415
copper with a reflow tin over copper flash finish, this project underscores our proficiency in
delivering high-quality components for automotive applications, with an annual volume of 1,550,000
blade terminals.

# Precision Sheet Metal Fabrication & Custom Component Manufacturing

**Guzman Manufacturing** is a custom contract manufacturer specializing in precision sheet metal
components for a wide variety of applications. This includes, but is not limited to steel, stainless
steel and aluminum (Also brass, inconel, mu-metal, copper and plastics).

Our 27,000 square foot facility is equipped with the machinery and know-how to handle any task,
large or small. Typical fabrication jobs include, but are not limited to: Electronics Chassis &
Frames; Enclosures, Assemblies, Cabinets & Panels; Brackets; Prototypes; Bus bars; Housings; Face
Plates and much more.

Our [services][27] include metal [laser cutting][28], precision sheet metal fabrication and
manufacturing.

We provice a variety of services that will exceed your requirements. Our services include:
* [Laser Cutting][29]

# Precision Sheet Metal Fabrication & Custom Component Manufacturing

**Guzman Manufacturing** is a custom contract manufacturer specializing in precision sheet metal
components for a wide variety of applications. This includes, but is not limited to steel, stainless
steel and aluminum (Also brass, inconel, mu-metal, copper and plastics).

Our 27,000 square foot facility is equipped with the machinery and know-how to handle any task,
large or small. Typical fabrication jobs include, but are not limited to: Electronics Chassis &
Frames; Enclosures, Assemblies, Cabinets & Panels; Brackets; Prototypes; Bus bars; Housings; Face
Plates and much more.

Our [services][27] include metal [laser cutting][28], precision sheet metal fabrication and
manufacturing.

## **Top Coolest Headquarters in the World**

Discover the top coolest headquarters and corporate offices in the world—iconic workplaces known for
innovative design, creative architecture, and inspiring office environments. These world-class
company headquarters set new standards for modern corporate office culture, blending functionality
with bold aesthetics to create spaces that employees genuinely enjoy working in every day.

From cutting-edge technology campuses to architecturally stunning corporate offices, these
headquarters showcase how thoughtful design, open collaboration spaces, and employee-focused
amenities can transform the workplace experience. Each headquarters highlights unique approaches to
office layout, sustainability, wellness, and creativity, making them a powerful source of
inspiration for corporate office management teams and business leaders worldwide.

To explore these incredible headquarters in action and see what makes them stand out, watch the
video below for a visual tour of some of the coolest corporate offices in the world:

If you have ever wondered what it would be like to work in a truly inspiring corporate environment,
these headquarters represent the ultimate vision of modern office life. They are not just
offices—they are destinations that reflect company culture, innovation, and forward-thinking
leadership, and they continue to influence how organizations design and manage their headquarters
across the globe.

## **What can you find in a company headquarters?**

In a company headquarters, you will typically find the organization’s leadership team along with its
most critical business functions. These departments and offices work together to manage strategy,
operations, and long-term growth:
* **Chief Executive Officer (CEO) Office** – Responsible for overall vision, leadership, and
  strategic decision-making.
* **Executive Team & Board of Directors** – Oversees corporate governance, policy direction, and
  high-level business objectives.
* **Administration Office** – Handles internal coordination, office management, and organizational
  support functions.
* **Finance, Accounting & Billing Department** – Manages budgets, financial reporting, payroll,
  billing, and compliance.
* **Marketing & Communications Department** – Develops branding, public relations, advertising, and
  internal and external communications.
* **Sales Department** – Drives revenue generation, client acquisition, and business development
  efforts.
* **Customer Service & Support** – Provides assistance to customers, manages inquiries, and resolves
  issues.
* **Research & Development Department** – Focuses on innovation, product development, and improving
  existing services or technologies.
* **Operations & Logistics** – Oversees daily business operations, supply chains, and operational
  efficiency.
* **Human Resources Department** – Manages recruitment, employee relations, benefits, training, and
  workplace policies.
* **Legal Department** – Handles contracts, regulatory compliance, risk management, and legal
  matters affecting the company.

Together, these offices form the operational and strategic core of a company, making the
headquarters the central hub for leadership, planning, and decision-making.

[Learn More][23]

Accurate, reliable components require properly designed, precisely built dies. Assemblies that meet
100% as-specified standards require exacting fixtures. Our tooling is conceived with the finished
product use in mind. After we engineer, design, model, and build these precise dies and fixtures,
our specialists will regularly inspect, repair as needed, and re-certify all tooling after every
production cycle.

[Full-Service Metal Stamping][Full-Service Metal Stamping]

### [Full-Service Metal Stamping][24]

[Learn More][25]

At HENSA, we blank, punch, pierce, extrude, fold, draw, and cut-to-length a wide range of sizes and
materials with our stamping presses. We regularly work with carbon steel, stainless, galvanized,
galvannealed, aluminum, brass, and copper. We utilize 14 stamping presses and five coil feed lines
to produce up to 3/8” thick continuously, 3/4” thick by unit, and 3/8” thick progressively.

[Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly][Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly]

### [Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly][26]

[Learn More][27]

Through the process of metal fabrication, HENSA is capable of building parts, components, weldments,
or complete assemblies from coil, sheet, bar stock, tubing, or plate. We regularly work with a broad
range of materials, from carbon and stainless steel to aluminum and beyond. We also work with a
number of exotic alloys. In their raw form, we regularly work with thicknesses from .02” up to 3/4”.

### [Kit Packaging Solutions & Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly][28]

[Learn More][29]

In conjunction with your packaging requirements, HENSA offers full assembly and kitting services.
HENSA often assembles kits for construction job sites in order to simplify field erection and
building construction. Years of industry experience have united us with some of the country’s best
packaging suppliers, allowing customers to enjoy our discounted supply rates.

### [High-Quality Metal Finishing][30]

[Learn More][31]

High-quality finishing for metal stampings extends the versatility of metal parts for both
decorative and protective purposes. It can also be used to enhance electrical conductivity and
solderability. HENSA offers treatments capable of meeting our customers’ specific requirements,
which can often include inspection methods, environmental regulations, and cosmetic criteria such as
color, gloss, texture, thickness, and other specialty features.

### [Forming Die Manufacturer with In-House Tool Making Capabilities| HENSA][22]

[Learn More][23]

Accurate, reliable components require properly designed, precisely built dies. Assemblies that meet
100% as-specified standards require exacting fixtures. Our tooling is conceived with the finished
product use in mind. After we engineer, design, model, and build these precise dies and fixtures,
our specialists will regularly inspect, repair as needed, and re-certify all tooling after every
production cycle.

[Full-Service Metal Stamping][Full-Service Metal Stamping]

### [Full-Service Metal Stamping][24]

[Learn More][25]

At HENSA, we blank, punch, pierce, extrude, fold, draw, and cut-to-length a wide range of sizes and
materials with our stamping presses. We regularly work with carbon steel, stainless, galvanized,
galvannealed, aluminum, brass, and copper. We utilize 14 stamping presses and five coil feed lines
to produce up to 3/8” thick continuously, 3/4” thick by unit, and 3/8” thick progressively.

[Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly][Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly]

### [Fabricating, Welding, & Subassembly][26]

[Learn More][27]

Through the process of metal fabrication, HENSA is capable of building parts, components, weldments,
or complete assemblies from coil, sheet, bar stock, tubing, or plate. We regularly work with a broad
range of materials, from carbon and stainless steel to aluminum and beyond. We also work with a
number of exotic alloys. In their raw form, we regularly work with thicknesses from .02” up to 3/4”.

[Kit Packaging Solutions & Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly][Kit Packaging Solutions &
Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly]

### [Kit Packaging Solutions & Packaging for Repeatable Field Assembly][28]

[Learn More][29]

In conjunction with your packaging requirements, HENSA offers full assembly and kitting services.
HENSA often assembles kits for construction job sites in order to simplify field erection and
building construction. Years of industry experience have united us with some of the country’s best
packaging suppliers, allowing customers to enjoy our discounted supply rates.

[High-Quality Metal Finishing][High-Quality Metal Finishing]

### [High-Quality Metal Finishing][30]

[Learn More][31]

High-quality finishing for metal stampings extends the versatility of metal parts for both
decorative and protective purposes. It can also be used to enhance electrical conductivity and
solderability. HENSA offers treatments capable of meeting our customers’ specific requirements,
which can often include inspection methods, environmental regulations, and cosmetic criteria such as
color, gloss, texture, thickness, and other specialty features.

## About us

### We Provide Exceptional Solutions for Clients

Since 1998, HRB Industries has mastered the fusion of high quality and low cost in custom metal
fabrication. Over the years, we’ve partnered with world-class OEM/ODM across diverse sectors,
continuously refining our processes to deliver superior value. We integrate skilled craftsmanship
with advanced technology—from sheet metal and CNC machining to casting, finishing, and
assembly—ensuring flawless products at competitive prices.
* Delivers precision-stamped and assembled components for home appliances, agriculture machinery,
  and automotive industries.
* Trusted by global brands like Electrolux and John Deere for quality, reliability, and speed.
* ISO-certified manufacturing with U.S. warehousing and full engineering support.

## [Frequently Asked Questions][74]

Click any question to expand — quick answers about our precision mold & stamping services

What is the typical lead time for a custom injection mold?

+

15-25 working days for standard precision molds (1-8 cavities). Complex multi-cavity or high-speed
stamping dies: 30-40 days. Expedited 7-15 day service available for urgent projects.

What precision tolerance can you achieve?

+

Plastic injection molds: ±0.005mm to ±0.01mm. Metal stamping parts: ±0.01mm to ±0.03mm. Precision
machining: ±0.002mm with Sodick wire EDM and Makino CNC equipment.

What materials do you work with?

+

Engineering plastics: LCP, PBT, PA66, PA6, PPS, PC/ABS, POM, ABS, PP, PE, TPU, TPE (Sabic, Dupont,
Celanese, BASF, LG Chem). Metals: Phosphor bronze, Brass, Beryllium copper, Stainless steel, CRS,
Aluminum.

Do you provide design support and DFM reports?

+

Yes, free DFM reporting included with every mold project. Within 24 hours of receiving your 3D CAD
file, our team provides analysis on draft angles, wall thickness, gate location, weld lines,
ejection design, and cost-saving suggestions.

What is your typical mold life expectancy?

+

Standard prototype: 10k-50k shots. Production molds (P20, 718H): 300k-500k shots. High-volume
hardened steel (S136, H13, D2): 1,000,000+ shots. Maintenance guidelines and spare parts
recommendations provided.

Do you offer prototyping before mass production?

+

Yes — three options: 1) Soft tooling / bridge molds for 500-5,000 samples (10-15 days). 2) 3D
printed SLA/SLS prototypes (3-5 days). 3) CNC machined prototypes from actual production materials
for functional testing.

What file formats do you accept for quotes?

+

2D: PDF, DWG, DXF. 3D: STEP (.stp, .step), IGES (.igs), SolidWorks (.sldprt), Parasolid (.x_t), STL,
Pro/E (.prt). Most quotes returned within 24 hours.

How do I get a quote? What information do you need?

+

Submit your inquiry via our contact form or email lishao@dgqrdz.cn. Please provide: 2D/3D CAD file,
material specification, annual quantity, target dimensions, tolerance requirements, and surface
finish needs.

## [Frequently Asked Questions][74]

Click any question to expand — quick answers about our precision mold & stamping services

What is the typical lead time for a custom injection mold?

+

15-25 working days for standard precision molds (1-8 cavities). Complex multi-cavity or high-speed
stamping dies: 30-40 days. Expedited 7-15 day service available for urgent projects.

What precision tolerance can you achieve?

+

Plastic injection molds: ±0.005mm to ±0.01mm. Metal stamping parts: ±0.01mm to ±0.03mm. Precision
machining: ±0.002mm with Sodick wire EDM and Makino CNC equipment.

What materials do you work with?

+

Engineering plastics: LCP, PBT, PA66, PA6, PPS, PC/ABS, POM, ABS, PP, PE, TPU, TPE (Sabic, Dupont,
Celanese, BASF, LG Chem). Metals: Phosphor bronze, Brass, Beryllium copper, Stainless steel, CRS,
Aluminum.

Do you provide design support and DFM reports?

+

Yes, free DFM reporting included with every mold project. Within 24 hours of receiving your 3D CAD
file, our team provides analysis on draft angles, wall thickness, gate location, weld lines,
ejection design, and cost-saving suggestions.

What is your typical mold life expectancy?

+

Standard prototype: 10k-50k shots. Production molds (P20, 718H): 300k-500k shots. High-volume
hardened steel (S136, H13, D2): 1,000,000+ shots. Maintenance guidelines and spare parts
recommendations provided.

Do you offer prototyping before mass production?

+

Yes — three options: 1) Soft tooling / bridge molds for 500-5,000 samples (10-15 days). 2) 3D
printed SLA/SLS prototypes (3-5 days). 3) CNC machined prototypes from actual production materials
for functional testing.

What file formats do you accept for quotes?

+

2D: PDF, DWG, DXF. 3D: STEP (.stp, .step), IGES (.igs), SolidWorks (.sldprt), Parasolid (.x_t), STL,
Pro/E (.prt). Most quotes returned within 24 hours.

How do I get a quote? What information do you need?

+

Submit your inquiry via our contact form or email lishao@dgqrdz.cn. Please provide: 2D/3D CAD file,
material specification, annual quantity, target dimensions, tolerance requirements, and surface
finish needs.

[Inven founders]
Ekku, Niilo, and Tommi
Co-founders, Inven

As analysts at McKinsey and BCG, we spent days searching for companies, piecing together ownership
and financial data, and rebuilding the same spreadsheets over and over again.

We thought there had to be a better way. In 2022, we set out to build it.

Since then, we’ve worked with 1,000+ M&A teams and spoken to thousands of professionals across
private equity, investment banking, consulting, and corporate development.

The core workflow is still the same — analyzing markets, finding the right companies, understanding
them, and reaching the right people. What’s changed is how it gets done.

That’s what we’re continuing to build: grounded in real data, shaped in close collaboration with the
teams doing the work, and evolving rapidly.

# Metal forming machines
# innovation and precision by LEIFELD

Metal forming is a key technology that significantly determines the development and performance of
our modern industry. From the automotive industry to hydrogen applications, lighting, wind energy,
oil & gas, food & chemical industry and aerospace – components manufactured by metal forming
machines can be found everywhere. In this demanding field, Leifeld Metal Spinning GmbH has
established itself as one of the leading machine tool manufacturers in special machine construction
with the LEIFELD and NIHON SPINDLE brands. **With over 130 years of experience** and team members
worldwide, we develop individual solutions for chipless metal forming in your industry!

[ Über uns ][97]
[ Lösungen ][98]
[Machine in factory environment]

## What are flow forming machines?

Metal fabrication tools such as **spinning and flow forming machines** form metals **without
cutting, i.e. without material loss**. In contrast to machining processes (e.g. milling or turning),
that produce chips, the metal is permanently **deformed by targeted pressure **during chipless
forming – for example in the form of a round blank or a preform that forms the desired contour when
rotated around a forming mandrel. The material therefore flows under force along a predetermined
shape – **precisely, efficiently and gently**. Depending on the metal forming process, **heat and
special tools** are also used to optimize the forming behavior. This results in rotationally
symmetrical components made from a wide variety of materials ideal for applications with special
requirements in terms of dimensional accuracy, weight, stability and cost-effectiveness.

As an internationally experienced manufacturer of metal forming machines, we at **LEIFELD **have
been developing and manufacturing **innovative and application-specific solutions **that set
standards worldwide since 1891. You too can rely on our expertise in metal forming machinery!

## Flow forming and spinning machines from LEIFELD

LEIFELD metal forming machinery is more than just technology – it is a key to **value creation and
process innovation**. Our metal fabrication tools enable companies to implement new production
routes, increase their productivity and set themselves apart from the competition in the long term.

Every industry places individual demands on spinning and forming machines. That is why we at LEIFELD
focus on **maximum flexibility, in-depth process understanding and customer orientation**. We are
proud to make a significant contribution to the further development of various industries worldwide
with our metalworking machinery.

Thanks to our intensive development work, our close exchange with customers and our in-house team of
experts, we create **innovative machines** for industrial metal shaping that outperform conventional
processes and are precisely tailored to our customers' requirements. Over 145 patents and numerous
tried-and-tested **Industry 4.0 applications** are proof of our innovative edge.

We also have a **globally unique application center **where all forming machines can be experienced
under one roof. Here, customers have the opportunity to test a wide variety of metal forming
machines live. Furthermore, they have the chance to manufacture prototypes and small series or carry
out tests and trials under real conditions. The center also serves the continuous **research and
development** of new solutions for chipless metal forming.

From the initial consultation, component design and process development to simulations, machine
installation, commissioning and after-sales service: We support our customers holistically –
competently, reliably and in a spirit of partnership

## Machine for metal forming: expertise meets quality of service

Our service is not an add-on, but a central element of our value proposition. We provide our
customers worldwide with comprehensive support: from precise **machine diagnostics** and predictable
**maintenance packages** to reliable spare parts management and **preventive maintenance
solutions**. Together with our customers, we develop individual maintenance concepts to minimize
downtimes and ensure the long-term efficiency of your production. Training courses, either at your
premises or at our **headquarters in Ahlen**, ensure that your machine operators can use their
systems efficiently and optimally.

### LEIFELD – trust that endures

Quality, innovation and reliability have always been the foundation of our business. Under the motto
**#metalperfected**, we not only supply cutting-edge technology for your metal forming process – we
think ahead. Our teams of experts offer sound advice, practical solutions and personal support
throughout the entire life cycle of your metal forming machinery. This results in long-term
partnerships based on trust and technological leadership.

### What does Leifeld offer?
* Mechanical engineering for metal forming
* Variety of process technologies: Spinning, Flow Forming, Shear Forming, Profiling, Necking-in
* Digital process optimization: simulations and component development
* Globally unique application center: machine demonstrations, prototype production, small series
  production, R&D, workshopsx
* Individual service: personal contacts for all concerns
* Flexible remote diagnostics: support by email, telephone or online access
* All-round support: advice and support before, during and after purchase
* Regular machine inspections and maintenance
* Efficient spare parts and maintenance management
* All-round carefree service packages
* Two training courses at our factory included
* Development support possible directly on site
* Retrofit solutions and tested used machines

### Spinning

In metal spinning, a rounded blank is transformed into a rotationally symmetrical hollow body by
chipless forming with a rotating spinning roller. The preform is clamped against a spinning chuck
and gradually formed with a spinning roller until it reaches the final contour. Additional
processing such as flanging or cutting off edges can be carried out in the same clamping.

the workpiece is lengthened. Variants such as forward and backward flow forming also allow

## Flow forming and spinning machines from LEIFELD

LEIFELD metal forming machinery is more than just technology – it is a key to **value creation and

We also have a **globally unique application center **where all forming machines can be experienced
under one roof. Here, customers have the opportunity to test a wide variety of metal forming
machines live. Furthermore, they have the chance to manufacture prototypes and small series or carry
out tests and trials under real conditions. The center also serves the continuous **research and
development** of new solutions for chipless metal forming.

installation, commissioning and after-sales service: We support our customers holistically –
competently, reliably and in a spirit of partnership

### Spinning

In metal spinning, a rounded blank is transformed into a rotationally symmetrical hollow body by
chipless forming with a rotating spinning roller. The preform is clamped against a spinning chuck
and gradually formed with a spinning roller until it reaches the final contour. Additional
processing such as flanging or cutting off edges can be carried out in the same clamping.

][114] [

### Flow Forming

In flow forming, a cylindrical or conical preform – typically a tube – is pushed onto a mandrel and
clamped. Several rotating flow forming rollers press synchronously from the outside against the
workpiece, causing the material to expand in an axial direction: the wall thickness is reduced and
the workpiece is lengthened. Variants such as forward and backward flow forming also allow
internally toothed parts to be produced.

Usually, base on your design drawings or original samples, we give some technical proposals and a
quotation to you, after your agreement, we produce for you.

### Can you make machining parts based on our samples?

Yes, we can make measurements based on your samples to make drawings for machining parts making.

Yes, all our raw materials and manufacturing processes fully comply with RoHS, REACH and relevant EU
regulatory standards.

at our cost until they match your requirements.

## FAQs

### Where can I get product & price information?

Upload you drawing in app.madearia.com or e-mail, we will contact you after upon receipt your mail.

### How soon can I get samples and how much the fee?

Depending on your specific project, it usually takes 7 to 15 days. the fee depends on the product
drawing, and the fee will be returned to your bulk order.

### How to enjoy the OEM services?

Usually, base on your design drawings or original samples, we give some technical proposals and a
quotation to you, after your agreement, we produce for you.

### Can you make machining parts based on our samples?

Yes, we can make measurements based on your samples to make drawings for machining parts making.

### Do your materials and processes comply with RoHS, REACH, or other EU standards?

Yes, all our raw materials and manufacturing processes fully comply with RoHS, REACH and relevant EU
regulatory standards.

### What if my parts do not meet the required specifications？

If the finished parts fail to meet your specs, we will revise or remanufacture them free of charge
at our cost until they match your requirements.

DEEP Manufacturing is not a conventional metal Additive Manufacturing company. Established to
support the wider DEEP Group’s ambition of enabling long-duration human habitation beneath the sea,

publicly reported investment across the UK and US.

facility and spoke with COO Louise Slade about how an ambitious subsea habitat programme created one
of the largest wire-arc DED operations.

### THE TECHNOLOGY

## What is metal Additive Manufacturing?

Metal Additive Manufacturing, also known as metal 3D printing, enables the production of complex
parts without many of the constraints of traditional manufacturing processes. 

It is defined as “the process of joining materials to make parts from 3D model data, usually layer
upon layer, as opposed to subtractive manufacturing and formative manufacturing methodologies.”

DEEP Manufacturing is not a conventional metal Additive Manufacturing company. Established to
support the wider DEEP Group’s ambition of enabling long-duration human habitation beneath the sea,
the privately backed organisation is part of a programme supported by more than $230 million in
publicly reported investment across the UK and US.

*Metal AM*’s Martin McMahon, Emma Lawn and Nick Williams visited DEEP Manufacturing’s Avonmouth
facility and spoke with COO Louise Slade about how an ambitious subsea habitat programme created one
of the largest wire-arc DED operations.

### THE TECHNOLOGY

## What is metal Additive Manufacturing?

Metal Additive Manufacturing, also known as metal 3D printing, enables the production of complex
parts without many of the constraints of traditional manufacturing processes. 

It is defined as “the process of joining materials to make parts from 3D model data, usually layer
upon layer, as opposed to subtractive manufacturing and formative manufacturing methodologies.”

### Precision Metal Stamping Applications

Precision metal stamping supports tight-tolerance components used in electronics, medical devices,
aerospace assemblies, and instrument-grade applications where repeatability matters. Suppliers in
this category produce small and complex stamped metal parts, terminals, contacts, clips, shields,
and formed components that must meet dimensional, material, and finishing requirements.

### Custom Metal Stamping Services

Custom metal stamping services are used when buyers need part geometries, tooling setups, alloys,
thicknesses, or production methods tailored to a specific application. These suppliers often support
stamped metal parts for enclosures, brackets, covers, housings, and formed components used in
transportation, construction products, industrial machinery, and consumer goods.

### Sheet Metal Stamping Capabilities

Sheet metal stamping companies focus on shaping flat stock into usable parts through blanking,
bending, punching, embossing, coining, and forming operations. This category is widely used for
panels, brackets, structural parts, and stamped steel components required in appliance
manufacturing, electrical equipment, building systems, and heavy equipment production.

### High-Volume Automotive Metal Stamping

Automotive metal stamping companies and high-volume stamping manufacturers typically support
demanding throughput requirements with progressive die, transfer die, and automated press
operations. Buyers sourcing metal stamping parts manufacturers for vehicle systems, hardware,
reinforcements, and production-line components often look for suppliers with consistent quality
systems, repeatable output, and experience with stamped metal parts manufacturer workflows at scale.

### Industry Applications of Metal Stamping

Automotive manufacturers rely on metal stamping manufacturing for brackets, body components,
reinforcements, and stamped steel parts that must hold tight tolerances across long production runs.
Electronics producers need precision metal stamping suppliers for contacts, terminals, shields, and
miniature formed parts. Aerospace applications call for lightweight, durable metal stampings used in
structural assemblies and support hardware. Medical device production depends on clean, accurate
stamped metal parts for instruments, housings, and specialty components. Construction and industrial
equipment sectors use sheet metal stamping for panels, supports, enclosures, and rugged formed parts
built for demanding environments.

progressive die or transfer press capacity, while lower-volume projects may fit short-run or
specialized custom metal stamping services. Matching throughput expectations to equipment, tooling,
and staffing helps avoid delays and unnecessary cost.

The stamping process also matters because not every supplier is built for the same part style. Some
focus on precision metal stampings with thin-gauge materials and intricate forms, while others are
better suited for larger stamped steel parts, deep-drawn shapes, or durable industrial components.
Buyers should compare process range, tonnage capability, and secondary operations.

### Integration With Manufacturing Systems

Integration with existing production lines should be reviewed before awarding work. That includes
material handling, tolerances, in-line finishing, assembly support, packaging requirements, and
whether the supplier can coordinate around downstream welding, fastening, coating, or inspection
steps. A capable metal stamping manufacturer should fit the broader manufacturing flow, not just
make the part.

Inspection and certification requirements should also be verified against the application. Buyers
may need dimensional inspection, material traceability, first article review, lot control, surface
finish verification, or industry-specific quality documentation. Evaluating supplier specialization
is especially important when parts serve regulated, safety-critical, or performance-sensitive
environments.

#### What is the difference between precision metal stamping and general stamping manufacturing?

Precision metal stamping usually refers to tighter tolerances, smaller features, and more exact

match your process, tooling, and inspection needs.

#### What should I compare when reviewing metal stamping manufacturers?

Compare press capacity, tooling approach, production volume range, material experience, finishing
options, and inspection standards. It also helps to review whether the supplier specializes in
precision metal stamping, sheet metal stamping, or high-volume stamped metal parts production. The
best match is usually the one aligned with your exact part requirements, not the broadest shop.

#### What is the difference between precision metal stamping and general stamping manufacturing?

Precision metal stamping usually refers to tighter tolerances, smaller features, and more exact
repeatability. General stamping manufacturing may cover a broader range of part sizes, materials,
and production styles, including larger or less intricate components. Buyers should choose based on
part complexity, critical dimensions, and end-use requirements.

#### How do I know which stamping process is right for my part?

The right stamping process depends on geometry, material, volume, tolerance, and downstream
requirements. Progressive die production often fits high-volume repeat parts, while other methods
may be better for larger components or more specialized forms. Supplier profiles and capability
descriptions can help narrow the best process fit before outreach.

lead times, and guarantees that your final product meets the highest standards of quality and
reliability.*

[*Learn More* ][41]

# [Tool & Die Solutions | Apprenticeship Program][42]

*Our Tool & Die Solutions team utilizes “the best of the best” technology and expertise to deliver
precision-crafted dies tailored to your specifications. Inside our fully equipped tool room, we
employ advanced grinding equipment and state-of-the-art Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM) to
ensure a flawless, precision fit for all progressive die components.*

*As part of our Apprenticeship Program, future tool & die makers gain hands-on experience with this
cutting-edge equipment, learning the skills required to design, assemble, and maintain Class A
tooling throughout its lifecycle. This combination of innovation and training ensures unmatched
quality for our customers and a strong career foundation for our apprentices.*

[*Learn More* ][43]

# **
# [
# Advanced Press Operations][44]
# **

*Our Press Operations feature an impressive range of 20 – 330-ton presses utilizing mechanical,
hydraulic, and advanced servo technologies. This diverse lineup provides unmatched flexibility for
producing parts of varying complexity and precision. Whether it’s high-speed stamping with
mechanical presses, deep-draw applications with hydraulic systems, or precision control with
servo-driven presses, we deliver optimal solutions for every project. Combined with our in-house
expertise and rigorous quality standards, these presses ensure consistent performance and superior
results across all production runs. *

[*Learn More* ][45]

# [Certifications & Quality][46]

*At MetalStamp Inc., we proudly accept the “Zero-Defect” challenge as a core principle of our
operations. Quality Assurance isn’t just a process—it’s a commitment embedded in every stage of
production. Certified by the U.S. Department of Labor and adhering to rigorous industry standards,
we implement advanced inspection protocols, precision measurement systems, and continuous
improvement practices to guarantee flawless results. From raw material verification to final product
validation, our team ensures that every component meets or exceeds customer specifications. This
dedication to quality not only strengthens our reputation but also reflects our promise to deliver
reliability, consistency, and excellence in every project. *

[*Learn More* ][47]

# Metco Fourslide Mfg, Inc

### ISO9001:2015/AS9100D

Metco Fourslide is a custom metal stamper, ISO 9001:2015 AS9100D certified, producing stamped
components based on customer design specifications. We accept all custom metal stamping challenges
to provide our customers with solutions.

 

**Low Cost Tooling is Guaranteed for the Life of the Program!**
* Specialists in the Manufacture of Miniature Formed Parts
* **Close Tolerances on Stamped Parts**
* Large or Small Quantities in Prototypes
* **Ultra Competitive Pricing with Stamping & CNC Technology!**
* Additional Services Include Welding, Assembly and Tapping

Metco Fourslide specializes in Precision Metal Stamping, Custom Metal Stamping, Fourslide Products,
Miniature Formed Parts, Miniature Stampings, Punch Press Stampings, Stamped Flat Springs, Stamped
Wire Forms and more.

## Family-Owned &
## Customer-Focused

MJ Celco is a family owned and managed precision metal stamping and sheet metal fabrication company
serving a variety of customers across the globe.  Since 1965, we’ve delivered a unique blend of
personal attention to detail, innovative problem-solving and quality workmanship that has made us a
leading supplier of metal stampings. 

With our broad range of capabilities, even the largest volume jobs move efficiently through our
modern plants. Place your trust in us, and we will provide high-level productivity, superior
quality, fast and informative customer service, and on-time delivery. That’s our promise to you. 

### Experienced

We’ve been in business for over 57 years, employing highly trained master technicians and staff.

### Certified

All locations are ISO 9001 and IATF 16949 certified to ensure process and product consistency.

### Innovative

We stay up to date on the latest engineering and technology to improve cost efficiencies.

### Reliable

We work tirelessly to understand your expectations and deadlines and to meet or exceed them.

Get customized solutions at a competitive price point. We work with all types of ferrous and
nonferrous metals, from coil to flat sheets, raw to pre-painted. Read more about our capabilities
below.

### Metal

### Engineering

### 3D Part Digitizing

Moeller Precision Tool’s ability to engineer and manufacture tooling for today’s demanding
production environments extends far beyond traditional engineering and design practices.Our
investment in the most current reverse engineering technology, including 3D laser scanning, allows
us to precisely capture critical part data, and then manufacture exact replicas.

### Engineering

Moeller’s experienced engineering staff provide unsurpassed quality and innovation for the special
tooling required in the metal stamping, forming, piercing and trimming industries. Our quality
practices apply to both standard and custom detail tooling, providing cost-effective manufacturing
while providing world class performance from every part produced.

### Facilities

The most technically advanced equipment, combined with a staff committed to its customers, continues
to propel Moeller Precision Tool towards leadership in the punch, die button, and special die detail
manufacturing business.
