## MSTFAB - Custom Sheet Metal Fabrication Factory in Guangzhou

MSTFAB supports overseas OEM buyers with drawing-based sheet metal parts, electrical enclosures,
cabinets, brackets, panels and welded assemblies. Our team handles [laser cutting and CNC
bending][156], [press brake bending][157], [welding and assembly][158], surface finishing,
inspection and export-ready packing under one roof.

For procurement teams in the USA, Europe and Australia, the goal is simple: fewer drawing surprises,
cleaner samples, stable batch quality and parts that arrive ready for assembly.

consistently produce extremely precise and high-quality products for our customers.

automation by way of robotic transfer.

## Why Choose Orick Stamping?

With the use of advanced leadership techniques and teamwork we strive to meet customer
expectations.  Our goal is to deliver total customer satisfaction through total quality culture. 
Our various capabilities and products include stamping, assembly, and multiple welding processes. 
Allow us to demonstrate what sets us aside from the competition.

[Orick-Shop-Images_GentrySmith_009-1-1024x686-1.jpg]

## Metal Stamping

A wide range of stamping capabilities makes us an ideal candidate for all stamped components.  Our
standard stampings include drawn cups, outer metal bushings, center bearing brackets, and varying
styles of brackets and plates for suspension, sub-frame, and other driveline components.

[Orick-Shop-Images_GentrySmith_047-1024x684-1.jpg]

## Welding & Assembly

Utilization of state-of-the-art controls, integrated systems, and robotics to MIG Weld and
Resistance Weld stamped and purchased components.  We also offer a range of robust and error proofed
assembly operations including press type staking of fasteners and components, plastic heat staking,
and rubber insert assembly.  We are always up for new and challenging assembly operations to add to
our growing capabilities.

[Orick-Shop-Images_GentrySmith_022-1024x683-1.jpg]

## Industry

Our main focus has been the Automotive Industry and mainly NVH/anti-vibration components for the
Tier 1 customer base.  We have also served the Heavy Truck, Appliance, and Agricultural Industries
and are always looking for the next industry we can support to add to our growing portfolio.

## A Leading Metal Manufacturing Company and Beyond

**An industry leader specializing in high-volume metal stamping, roll forming, welding, decorating,
and assembly.**

**Offering agile, precision fabrication to meet the growing demand for complex, lower-volume metal
components.**

**Providing global supply chain options including plastic injection molding, machining, powder
metal, fasteners, and multi-slide components.**

We combine rigorous quality systems, deep engineering expertise, and a partnership-first mindset to
deliver reliable, high-performance manufacturing solutions.

## Data Center Solutions

### Quality

**Pennant’s quality assurance expertise in manufacturing is rooted in rigorous standards and
continuous improvement practices. We ensure consistent product quality and performance across every
production cycle.**

### Engineering

**Pennant’s engineering team combines deep industry expertise with innovative design solutions to
ensure optimal manufacturability and performance for each product.**

### Partnership

**Our principles, vision, and goal are to be easy to do business with and to serve as a trusted
partner and extension of your business in the U.S. and global marketplace.**

## Our Metal Fabrication and Manufacturing Services

Our reputation as one of the top metal fabrication suppliers in the U.S. is built on innovation,
quality, and a deep commitment to serving our customers’ evolving needs. Here is what our offerings
include:

### Assembly

meet the diverse needs of multiple industries, including automotive, solar, home appliances,
agriculture, and more.

requirements. From cutting and forming to welding and finishing, our expert team ensures every part
is crafted to exact specifications.

[

Pennant brings extensive expertise in metal stamping for manufacturing industries, offering a full

# Metal forming Solutions Provider

## A Leading Metal Manufacturing Company and Beyond

**An industry leader specializing in high-volume metal stamping, roll forming, welding, decorating,
and assembly.**

**Offering agile, precision fabrication to meet the growing demand for complex, lower-volume metal
components.**

**Providing global supply chain options including plastic injection molding, machining, powder
metal, fasteners, and multi-slide components.**

❮

## Built on Quality. Powered by Engineering. Driven by Partnership

We combine rigorous quality systems, deep engineering expertise, and a partnership-first mindset to
deliver reliable, high-performance manufacturing solutions.

## Data Center Solutions

### Quality

**Pennant’s quality assurance expertise in manufacturing is rooted in rigorous standards and
continuous improvement practices. We ensure consistent product quality and performance across every
production cycle.**

### Engineering

**Pennant’s engineering team combines deep industry expertise with innovative design solutions to
ensure optimal manufacturability and performance for each product.**

### Partnership

**Our principles, vision, and goal are to be easy to do business with and to serve as a trusted
partner and extension of your business in the U.S. and global marketplace.**

## Our Metal Fabrication and Manufacturing Services

Our reputation as one of the top metal fabrication suppliers in the U.S. is built on innovation,
quality, and a deep commitment to serving our customers’ evolving needs. Here is what our offerings
include:

[

### Assembly

At Pennant, we specialize in delivering comprehensive manufacturing assembly solutions tailored to
meet the diverse needs of multiple industries, including automotive, solar, home appliances,
agriculture, and more.

][75]

### Assembly

[

### Fabrication

Pennant provides precision metal fabrication solutions tailored to meet diverse industry
requirements. From cutting and forming to welding and finishing, our expert team ensures every part
is crafted to exact specifications.

][76]

### Fabrication

[

### Metal Stamping

Pennant brings extensive expertise in metal stamping for manufacturing industries, offering a full
suite of capabilities including progressive, hand transfer, deep draw, decorative, and pre-paint
stamping.

][77]

### Metal Stamping

[

### Powder Coating & Silk Screening

Pennant partners with trusted providers for powder coating, silk screening, heat treating, plating,
E-coating, salt spray, and other performance testing services.

][78]

### Powder Coating & Silk Screening

[

### Roll Forming

With decades of experience, Pennant delivers high-quality roll forming solutions tailored for varied
manufacturing needs. We form complex shapes from a wide range of flexible materials.

][79]

### Roll Forming

[

### Welding & Finishing

Pennant offers metal fabrication welding and assembly solutions to meet the highest standards in
manufacturing. Our advanced automation and in-line welding create seamless joints for added strength
and long-lasting performance

][80]

### Welding & Finishing

## INDUSTRIES

Our facilities in Ohio support clients throughout the U.S., delivering metal fabricated components
with consistent quality and timely delivery.

[Taiwan Stamping Parts Manufacturer]
Manufacturing Technique and Capabilities:

Sheng Ching, professional stamping parts manufacturer in Taiwan since 1986, focuses on precision
press processing and provides manufacturing and fabrication services for custom machining parts.

Materials handled include iron, stainless steel, brass, red copper, zinc alloy, aluminum, and
plastics. Complete one-stop service is offered, from packaging design, drafting, and prototype
development to finished product assembly and contract assembly.

Stamping is a process that uses dies and presses to form metal sheets into the required shapes. The
sheet is placed in the die, the press applies downward pressure, the metal deforms or is sheared
under the pressure, and finally forms stable parts suitable for mass production.

### Manufacturing Ecosystem

#### Engineering-driven integration—from concept to assembly.

Shilpan Steelcast operates a fully integrated manufacturing ecosystem built around engineering-led
execution. From early-stage design collaboration and process engineering to investment casting,
precision machining, assembly, and strategic sourcing, every stage is aligned under a single
technical and quality framework.

Complementary components produced through forging, die casting, MIM, stamping, or other methods are
developed or sourced through qualified partners under unified engineering oversight. This
ecosystem-driven approach ensures dimensional compatibility, consistent quality standards, and
seamless integration of multi-process components into finished assemblies.

This ecosystem approach allows Shilpan to move beyond build-to-print execution. By combining
engineering insight with manufacturing control, we help OEMs shorten development cycles, reduce
downstream corrections, and industrialize components that are ready for stable, repeatable
production from day one.

[Manufacturing Service][Manufacturing Service]

### [Program Ownership][Program Ownership]
### Program Ownership

[Program Ownership][Program Ownership]

### Program Ownership

#### Clear ownership across every stage of the project.

Complex manufacturing programs demand clear ownership. Shilpan Steelcast provides program-level
accountability by acting as a single responsible partner from component development through final
delivery. Engineering, manufacturing, quality, and logistics teams operate within one coordinated
structure.

This model reduces supplier fragmentation, accelerates issue resolution, and improves execution
reliability. With accountability clearly defined, OEMs gain better visibility, faster
decision-making, and confidence that performance, timelines, and quality are managed under one
ownership model.

Program accountability at Shilpan is reinforced through structured reviews, cross-functional
coordination, and disciplined change management. Design updates, process refinements, and supply
adjustments are evaluated within a single program framework, ensuring decisions are aligned with
performance, cost, and delivery objectives.

[program-ownership][program-ownership]

[Global Execution][Global Execution]

### Global Execution

#### Built around global schedules, not local constraints.

Shilpan Steelcast supports global OEM programs through disciplined execution models aligned with
real-world production schedules. Structured planning, flexible capacity, and strategic warehousing
in the USA and Europe enable smooth coordination across regions and time zones.

By integrating manufacturing execution with logistics planning, Shilpan supports Just-In-Time and
KANBAN systems without disrupting downstream operations. This approach helps customers maintain
production continuity while reducing inventory pressure and operational risk.

This execution discipline enables Shilpan Steelcast to support both steady-state production and
dynamic demand environments. Whether scaling volumes, managing part revisions, or responding to
schedule changes, our global execution model is designed to adapt without compromising delivery
reliability or quality consistency.

### [Manufacturing Ecosystem][Manufacturing Ecosystem]
### Manufacturing Ecosystem

[Manufacturing Ecosystem][Manufacturing Ecosystem]

### Manufacturing Ecosystem

#### Engineering-driven integration—from concept to assembly.

Shilpan Steelcast operates a fully integrated manufacturing ecosystem built around engineering-led
execution. From early-stage design collaboration and process engineering to investment casting,
precision machining, assembly, and strategic sourcing, every stage is aligned under a single
technical and quality framework.

Complementary components produced through forging, die casting, MIM, stamping, or other methods are
developed or sourced through qualified partners under unified engineering oversight. This
ecosystem-driven approach ensures dimensional compatibility, consistent quality standards, and
seamless integration of multi-process components into finished assemblies.

This ecosystem approach allows Shilpan to move beyond build-to-print execution. By combining
engineering insight with manufacturing control, we help OEMs shorten development cycles, reduce
downstream corrections, and industrialize components that are ready for stable, repeatable
production from day one.

[Manufacturing Service][Manufacturing Service]

### [Program Ownership][Program Ownership]
### Program Ownership

[Program Ownership][Program Ownership]

### Program Ownership

#### Clear ownership across every stage of the project.

Complex manufacturing programs demand clear ownership. Shilpan Steelcast provides program-level
accountability by acting as a single responsible partner from component development through final
delivery. Engineering, manufacturing, quality, and logistics teams operate within one coordinated
structure.

This model reduces supplier fragmentation, accelerates issue resolution, and improves execution
reliability. With accountability clearly defined, OEMs gain better visibility, faster
decision-making, and confidence that performance, timelines, and quality are managed under one
ownership model.

Program accountability at Shilpan is reinforced through structured reviews, cross-functional
coordination, and disciplined change management. Design updates, process refinements, and supply
adjustments are evaluated within a single program framework, ensuring decisions are aligned with
performance, cost, and delivery objectives.

[program-ownership][program-ownership]

### [Global Execution][Global Execution]
### Global Execution

[Global Execution][Global Execution]

### Global Execution

#### Built around global schedules, not local constraints.

Shilpan Steelcast supports global OEM programs through disciplined execution models aligned with
real-world production schedules. Structured planning, flexible capacity, and strategic warehousing
in the USA and Europe enable smooth coordination across regions and time zones.

By integrating manufacturing execution with logistics planning, Shilpan supports Just-In-Time and
KANBAN systems without disrupting downstream operations. This approach helps customers maintain
production continuity while reducing inventory pressure and operational risk.

This execution discipline enables Shilpan Steelcast to support both steady-state production and
dynamic demand environments. Whether scaling volumes, managing part revisions, or responding to
schedule changes, our global execution model is designed to adapt without compromising delivery
reliability or quality consistency.

# SIGMA Engineered Solutions

Serving industries from automotive to telecom and everything in between, we design, build, source,
and deliver precision parts that enhance high-quality products worldwide. 

## Your Success is Our Mission

Our end-to-end solutions help keep cars on the road, planes in the air, and data centers humming
across the globe. When your goals meet our expertise, there's no limit to what you can achieve.
Your One-Stop Shop
We make it easy for you by being your one-stop shop for all your manufacturing needs. Our extensive
capabilities, from casting and precision metal stamping to in-house tooling, allow us to design,
build and source innovative solutions specifically tailored to you.
Partnering Across Industries
Since 1982, we've built lasting relationships with global market leaders, delivering precision-made
products and solutions that cater to a wide range of connectivity needs. Let us help you stay ahead
in your industry.
Unparalleled Speed & Service
Our commitment to you includes industry-leading fill rates and supply chain solutions that cut
typical lead times down to as little as 5 days. This means we can quickly adapt to fluctuations in
demand and help you get your products to market faster.

## Castings

Global manufacturer of die castings, sand castings, and investment castings with more than 260
metal/alloy combinations.

[Learn More][107]

## Sourcing Solutions

Your go-to sourcing partner for top-quality forgings, castings, stampings, plastic injection
molding, machining, and more.

[LEARN MORE][108]

## Stamping & Swiss Screws

High-quality precision metal stamping, specializing in tight tolerance products with complex
geometry.

[LEARN MORE][109]

# Your Global Supply Chain Partner

#### We provide global manufacturing capabilities with local expertise.

Headquartered in Garner, N.C., we have a global manufacturing presence across the U.S., India, and
Mexico, as well as third-party sourcing capabilities in China. Our North Carolina-based warehouse
and logistics facility reduces fulfillment rates to as little as 5 days.

[Our Locations][110]

## Contact Us

From new product design to product re-engineering, we’re ready to help create a solution that works
for you.

# SIGMA Engineered Solutions

Serving industries from automotive to telecom and everything in between, we design, build, source,
and deliver precision parts that enhance high-quality products worldwide. 

## Your Success is Our Mission

Our end-to-end solutions help keep cars on the road, planes in the air, and data centers humming
across the globe. When your goals meet our expertise, there's no limit to what you can achieve.
Your One-Stop Shop
We make it easy for you by being your one-stop shop for all your manufacturing needs. Our extensive
capabilities, from casting and precision metal stamping to in-house tooling, allow us to design,
build and source innovative solutions specifically tailored to you.
Partnering Across Industries
Since 1982, we've built lasting relationships with global market leaders, delivering precision-made
products and solutions that cater to a wide range of connectivity needs. Let us help you stay ahead
in your industry.
Unparalleled Speed & Service
Our commitment to you includes industry-leading fill rates and supply chain solutions that cut
typical lead times down to as little as 5 days. This means we can quickly adapt to fluctuations in
demand and help you get your products to market faster.

## Castings

Global manufacturer of die castings, sand castings, and investment castings with more than 260
metal/alloy combinations.

[Learn More][107]

## Sourcing Solutions

Your go-to sourcing partner for top-quality forgings, castings, stampings, plastic injection
molding, machining, and more.

[LEARN MORE][108]

## Stamping & Swiss Screws

High-quality precision metal stamping, specializing in tight tolerance products with complex
geometry.

[LEARN MORE][109]

# Your Global Supply Chain Partner

#### We provide global manufacturing capabilities with local expertise.

Headquartered in Garner, N.C., we have a global manufacturing presence across the U.S., India, and
Mexico, as well as third-party sourcing capabilities in China. Our North Carolina-based warehouse
and logistics facility reduces fulfillment rates to as little as 5 days.

[Our Locations][110]

## Contact Us

From new product design to product re-engineering, we’re ready to help create a solution that works
for you.

## The Safest Way to Back Up Your Seed Phrase

[PROBLEM]

Memory fades.

[SOLUTION]

Metal stamping deeply embeds your recovery phrase into solid titanium - creating a physical,

## True Cold Storage

### Permanently Offline

Never connected. Never exposed to digital threats.

### Independent of Devices

No hardware required — your backup can stand on its own.

### No Third Parties

Full control stays with you. No reliance on anyone else.

### No Cloud Exposure

Nothing stored online. Nothing to hack.

## Trusted by HODLers

“

Bitcoin in self-custody puts you in control, but with that comes responsibility. Lose your seed
phrase, and your Bitcoin is gone, so storing it properly is critical.

Most people just write their seed words on paper, which is fragile. That’s why I use Stamp Seed — it
gives me everything I need to easily stamp my seed phrase into titanium, so it survives the test of
time.

### Nico Moran

Host, Simply Bitcoin

“

Stamp Seed is one of the most robust solutions I've seen for protecting a crypto recovery phrase. By
stamping your seed phrase into titanium, it becomes fireproof, waterproof, fade-proof, tear-proof,
and extremely resistant to physical damage.

For anyone serious about self-custody, it's a simple and incredibly durable way to safeguard your
keys.

### Rex Kneisley

Host, The CryptoDad

“

I had a chance to test the Stamp Seed kit recently and I must say, it's a premium tier kit.

The jig makes it easy to keep the stamp aligned and the brass tipped hammer is the best I've ever
used because it absorbs the strike shock better than steel.

### Jameson Lopp

Cypherpunk, @lopp

“

I used to get nervous having my Bitcoin backup words written on flimsy paper.
That all changed when I met the Stamp Seed team at a conference in Prague in 2023. They walked me
through the process, and stamping my words into titanium was far easier than I expected. When I got
home from that trip, I secured the wallets holding my generational wealth.

### Luke Mikic

Host, Luke Mikic

## Frequently Asked
## Questions

What are seed words?

Also known as a recovery phrase (or simply “seed”), it’s a list of words in a specific order that
contains everything needed to restore your wallet. It’s typically generated automatically by a
hardware wallet (such as Ledger, Trezor, or Coldcard) and usually consists of 12–24 words.

Does it support 12- and 24-word seed phrases?

Yes. We offer different plate options for both 12- and 24-word setups. You choose your preferred
format when selecting your kit.

How long does it take?

Typically 30–60 minutes, depending on the number of words and your pace.

What if I make a mistake?

Each kit includes a practice titanium piece to help you get comfortable, and each stamp is clearly
marked for easy identification and proper orientation—

Also known as a recovery phrase (or simply “seed”), it’s a list of words in a specific order that
contains everything needed to restore your wallet. It’s typically generated automatically by a
hardware wallet (such as Ledger, Trezor, or Coldcard) and usually consists of 12–24 words.

Does it support 12- and 24-word seed phrases?

Yes. We offer different plate options for both 12- and 24-word setups. You choose your preferred
format when selecting your kit.

How long does it take?

Typically 30–60 minutes, depending on the number of words and your pace.

What if I make a mistake?

Each kit includes a practice titanium piece to help you get comfortable, and each stamp is clearly
marked for easy identification and proper orientation—so errors are rare.

If you make a mistake, stamp an “X” over the character and continue—most cells have space for
corrections. You can also use the side lines to restamp the full word if needed.

every time.

## What We Do

##### IN-HOUSE CONTROLS AND CONSISTENCY FROM DESIGN THROUGH DELIVERY

Standard Die is a full-service drawing and stamping company. Beyond drawing of standard steel
products we also excel at obtaining exotic materials to meet your design requirements. Our team
welcomes new and challenging material types to fit your project! We manufacture, clean, assemble and
deliver unique premium parts. At every stage of production, you will enjoy the full support of our
friendly, qualified Standard Die team.

### Design & Engineering

#### Creative thinkers who can help solve your engineering challenges

We use the latest CAD software and other top of the line engineering programs to help bring your
print or idea to life. Our experienced design engineers will help you to get the most competitive
pricing and work alongside you throughout the process of creating your perfect product. 

[Learn More][56]

### Tooling

#### We make and service dies in-house saving you time and money

Our skilled expert Die Makers have worked in almost every industry imaginable; building our own
dies, doing our own stamping and can suit any level of production: short-run, prototype, high
volume, and more! We make the stamping process painless for you.

[Learn More][57]

### Stamping & Deep Drawn Parts

#### Prototypes to large volumes. thicknesses from .002” to 0.15”

We’ve built our reputation on the precision and quality of our drawn cups, cans, crucibles and cones
made from refractory metals. We work with every industry and have over 55 years of experience in
working with the tightest tolerances and the most precious materials.

[Learn More][58]

### Cleaning & Assembly

#### Our unique sd clean process ensures your parts will be pristine

The Standard Die cleaning process is environmentally friendly and ensures that your parts are
spotless and ready for use as soon as you receive them. We can even assemble parts with unparalleled
precision and alway perform our thorough quality check.  

[Learn More][59]

### Warehousing

#### We ease your burden and save you time and money

We offer complete, secure, climate-controlled warehousing and vendor managed inventory services at
Standard Die International. Ensure the logistics of your orders are on track with our client
reports, EDI capability and lot control.

[Learn More][60]

## Who We Serve

### We’ve met these industries’ challenges. Let us meet yours.

#### [OIL][61]. [MEDICAL][62]. [AEROSPACE][63] AND MORE.

At Standard Die International, we go above and beyond to deliver superior products precisely
tailored to our customers' most stringent metal stamping requirements. We're dedicated to saving
companies time and money by providing them with high-performance, defect-free products on time,
every time.

## What We Do

##### IN-HOUSE CONTROLS AND CONSISTENCY FROM DESIGN THROUGH DELIVERY

Standard Die is a full-service drawing and stamping company. Beyond drawing of standard steel
products we also excel at obtaining exotic materials to meet your design requirements. Our team
welcomes new and challenging material types to fit your project! We manufacture, clean, assemble and
deliver unique premium parts. At every stage of production, you will enjoy the full support of our
friendly, qualified Standard Die team.

### Design & Engineering

#### Creative thinkers who can help solve your engineering challenges

We use the latest CAD software and other top of the line engineering programs to help bring your
print or idea to life. Our experienced design engineers will help you to get the most competitive
pricing and work alongside you throughout the process of creating your perfect product. 

[Learn More][56]

### Tooling

#### We make and service dies in-house saving you time and money

Our skilled expert Die Makers have worked in almost every industry imaginable; building our own
dies, doing our own stamping and can suit any level of production: short-run, prototype, high
volume, and more! We make the stamping process painless for you.

[Learn More][57]

### Stamping & Deep Drawn Parts

#### Prototypes to large volumes. thicknesses from .002” to 0.15”

We’ve built our reputation on the precision and quality of our drawn cups, cans, crucibles and cones
made from refractory metals. We work with every industry and have over 55 years of experience in
working with the tightest tolerances and the most precious materials.

[Learn More][58]

### Cleaning & Assembly

#### Our unique sd clean process ensures your parts will be pristine

The Standard Die cleaning process is environmentally friendly and ensures that your parts are
spotless and ready for use as soon as you receive them. We can even assemble parts with unparalleled
precision and alway perform our thorough quality check.  

[Learn More][59]

### Warehousing

#### We ease your burden and save you time and money

We offer complete, secure, climate-controlled warehousing and vendor managed inventory services at
Standard Die International. Ensure the logistics of your orders are on track with our client
reports, EDI capability and lot control.

[Learn More][60]

## Who We Serve

### We’ve met these industries’ challenges. Let us meet yours.

#### [OIL][61]. [MEDICAL][62]. [AEROSPACE][63] AND MORE.

From our roots supplying the auto industry through our growth making parts for the oil and gas
industry, we’ve successfully served leading global companies requiring some of the most stringent
specifications. Whether it’s a delicate bracket or a deep drawn tantalum cup, our experience
creating these parts should help you believe that we could make your parts too.

### We adapt to new industries, but our standards never change.

#### WE LISTEN. WE LEARN. WE PRODUCE.

Before we begin making parts for any new customer we take time to carefully listen and find out
their unique needs and specifications. We will form a partnership with you from the very beginning.
Whatever your industry and need is, we will respect and absorb your knowledge, and strengthen it
with our unique expertise of metal stamping. Working together, we will produce the finest quality
parts. And our customer service will make sure your purchasing process is cost effective and
painless.

### We make customer service our top priority.

#### ATTENTIVE. RESPONSIVE. FRIENDLY. FOLLOW UP.

From the friendly voice of our receptionist to the very accessible brain trust of our top
executives, we listen to your concerns and respond quickly and appropriately. We make the buying of
metal stampings painless by cultivating a partnership environment with our customers and servicing
them beyond expectations. We focus on each customer individually. Your calls will be answered
quickly and you will be given regular job status reports. You’ll enjoy a one-on-one working
relationship that is open, transparent and effective. We believe in establishing long-term
partnerships with our customers and will make personal visits to your facilities to see your needs
first hand. You’ll work directly with our [design engineers][64] and enjoy an active role in
Standard Die’s design, manufacturing and delivery cycles.

## Precision Metal Stamping

Our [custom metal stamping capabilities][103] enable us to manufacture speciality metal parts, form
brackets to cans to rings and more. Standard Die specializes in close tolerances, using our
extensive industry knowledge and experience to meet even the tightest, most unyielding stamping
requirements without sacrificing quality. Our expert staff is highly skilled in drawing and stamping
materials into unique shapes and thicknesses, finalizing most projects within seven days.

Our press room enables us to draw and stamp metals with the following competencies:
* Air presses
* Hydraulic presses
* Line dies
* Compound dies
* Transfer presses
* Mechanical presses
* [Progressive stampings][104]
* [Metal bending][105]

* Complete confidentiality
* One on one responsive service
* Fast quotations
* Vendor Managed Inventory
* Long-term customer relationships with little turnover
* Delivery 7 days or less
* Fastest reaction and turnaround in the industry

We settle for nothing less than the highest-quality parts. That’s why we maintain a [superior

## About Standard Die

### History of excellence & service.

#### FOUNDED IN 1970

When Al Menzies Sr. established [Standard Die][108] over 55 years ago, his plan was simple: stand
out from the competition. As the first metal stamper to the industrial diamond industry, he was
unwilling to compromise his values. He made sure integrity, customer service and quality were
integrated into every aspect of the business and, as a result, designed and manufactured some of the
world’s finest products for the industrial diamond industry.

> ##### Our Mission:
> 
> ###### “To make the purchasing of metal stampings painless.”

By pursuing this mission for more than five decades, we have grown from a start up tool and die
operation to a world-class metal stamping company. With more than a billion parts delivered, we have
provided precision drawing and stamping services to customers spanning the industrial diamond,
automotive, aircraft, electrical and medical industries across the globe.

[Learn More][109]

## Quality American Manufacturing Services – From Design to Delivery

final delivery. Innovative, cost-effective, and with the capacity to deliver the results you need on

## FAQs
* [ Q1. What services does Stone City Products provide? ][37]
  
  At Stone City Products, we specialize in custom metal manufacturing solutions, including precision
  metal stamping, sheet metal fabrication, forming, punching, bending, welding, and secondary
  finishing services. We work closely with businesses to deliver high-quality custom components
  tailored to their project requirements.
* [ Q2. What is precision metal stamping, and how does Stone City Products handle it? ][38]
  
  At Stone City Products, our precision metal stamping process transforms flat sheet metal into
  highly accurate custom parts using advanced tooling and modern stamping presses. We focus on
  maintaining tight tolerances and consistent quality for every production run.
* [ Q3. Why should I choose Stone City Products for my metal stamping project? ][39]
  
  Stone City Products combines decades of manufacturing expertise, advanced production equipment,
  strict quality control, and custom engineering support to deliver reliable metal components with
  fast turnaround times and consistent production quality.
* [ Q4. What materials does Stone City Products work with for metal stamping? ][40]
  
  We work with a wide range of materials including stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, copper,
  brass, and specialty alloys. Our team helps select the right material based on your application,
  durability needs, and production requirements.
* [ Q5. What are the advantages of working with an experienced company like Stone City Products?
  ][41]
  
  By partnering with Stone City Products, customers benefit from reduced production errors, improved
  manufacturing efficiency, consistent product quality, and expert support throughout the design and
  production process.
* [ Q6. Which industries does Stone City Products serve? ][42]
  
  Stone City Products proudly serves industries such as automotive, transportation, industrial
  equipment, agriculture, electronics, and other manufacturing sectors requiring durable,
  precision-engineered metal components.
* [ Q7. Can Stone City Products handle custom manufacturing projects? ][43]
  
  Yes. We specialize in custom manufacturing and can produce unique metal components based on
  engineering drawings, CAD files, prototypes, and specific production requirements tailored to your
  business needs.
* [ Q8. Why choose metal stamping over other manufacturing methods? ][44]
  
  Metal stamping offers faster production speeds, reduced material waste, excellent repeatability,
  and lower per-unit costs for high-volume production. At Stone City Products, we use advanced
  stamping processes to maximize both efficiency and quality.
* [ Q9. Does Stone City Products offer services beyond metal stamping? ][45]
  
  Yes. In addition to metal stamping, we provide CNC machining, welding, assembly, finishing,
  deburring, powder coating, e-coating, and custom sheet metal fabrication to support complete
  manufacturing solutions.
* [ Q10. How quickly can Stone City Products complete production? ][46]
  
  Production timelines depend on project complexity, tooling requirements, and order volume. Our
  team focuses on streamlined manufacturing processes to ensure efficient lead times while
  maintaining the highest quality standards.

# Precision Metal Fabrication, Stamping, and Machining

Stone City Products specializes in comprehensive metal fabrication, stamping, and [CNC machining
services][31]. Backed by more than 75 years of precision American manufacturing, we understand that
a combination of quality, value, convenience, and speed are all priorities in today’s market. As one
of the Midwest’s most well-established [sheet metal fabrication][32] companies, we ensure superior
results with rapid delivery according to your exact specifications and project schedule.

We also offer a full selection of value-added operations to streamline your project and minimize
turnaround time. With our integration of highly advanced [sheet metal stamping][33] and fabrication
technology, Stone City offers both the capability and capacity to complete almost any custom
fabrication project to the most exceptionally high standard.

customers with superior American manufacturing quality combined with rapid delivery and the highest
production standards.
[We manufacture precision machined parts that meet even the most challenging specifications set
forth by our customers. Our facility integrates a full-service CNC machining department to meet
these requirements with rapid turnaround and on-time delivery. Backed by more than 75 years of

From concept to completion, Stone City can streamline your project and optimize the production
process every step of the way. We strive to ensure superior results in every phase, from design to
final delivery. Innovative, cost-effective, and with the capacity to deliver the results you need on
time and within the agreed budget… Stone City is the contract manufacturer of choice for a growing
number of businesses throughout the Indiana region, the greater Midwest, and beyond. Request a quote
up top or give us a call at [(800) 960-3373][35] to discuss your developing project.

## FAQs
* [ Q1. What services does Stone City Products provide? ][37]
  
  At Stone City Products, we specialize in custom metal manufacturing solutions, including precision
  metal stamping, sheet metal fabrication, forming, punching, bending, welding, and secondary
  finishing services. We work closely with businesses to deliver high-quality custom components
  tailored to their project requirements.
* [ Q2. What is precision metal stamping, and how does Stone City Products handle it? ][38]
  
  At Stone City Products, our precision metal stamping process transforms flat sheet metal into
  highly accurate custom parts using advanced tooling and modern stamping presses. We focus on
  maintaining tight tolerances and consistent quality for every production run.
* [ Q3. Why should I choose Stone City Products for my metal stamping project? ][39]
  
  Stone City Products combines decades of manufacturing expertise, advanced production equipment,
  strict quality control, and custom engineering support to deliver reliable metal components with
  fast turnaround times and consistent production quality.
* [ Q4. What materials does Stone City Products work with for metal stamping? ][40]
  
  We work with a wide range of materials including stainless steel, aluminum, carbon steel, copper,
  brass, and specialty alloys. Our team helps select the right material based on your application,
  durability needs, and production requirements.
* [ Q5. What are the advantages of working with an experienced company like Stone City Products?
  ][41]
  
  By partnering with Stone City Products, customers benefit from reduced production errors, improved
  manufacturing efficiency, consistent product quality, and expert support throughout the design and
  production process.
* [ Q6. Which industries does Stone City Products serve? ][42]
  
  Stone City Products proudly serves industries such as automotive, transportation, industrial
  equipment, agriculture, electronics, and other manufacturing sectors requiring durable,
  precision-engineered metal components.
* [ Q7. Can Stone City Products handle custom manufacturing projects? ][43]
  
  Yes. We specialize in custom manufacturing and can produce unique metal components based on
  engineering drawings, CAD files, prototypes, and specific production requirements tailored to your
  business needs.
* [ Q8. Why choose metal stamping over other manufacturing methods? ][44]
  
  Metal stamping offers faster production speeds, reduced material waste, excellent repeatability,
  and lower per-unit costs for high-volume production. At Stone City Products, we use advanced
  stamping processes to maximize both efficiency and quality.
* [ Q9. Does Stone City Products offer services beyond metal stamping? ][45]
  
  Yes. In addition to metal stamping, we provide CNC machining, welding, assembly, finishing,
  deburring, powder coating, e-coating, and custom sheet metal fabrication to support complete
  manufacturing solutions.
* [ Q10. How quickly can Stone City Products complete production? ][46]
  
  Production timelines depend on project complexity, tooling requirements, and order volume. Our
  team focuses on streamlined manufacturing processes to ensure efficient lead times while
  maintaining the highest quality standards.

## Sunrise Die Casting Technology

We use the right casting method based on your design and performance requirements, delivering high
precision, mechanical strength, and good performance parts for you.
[High Pressure Die Casting][117]
High pressure die casting is our primary core manufacturing focus. We produce complex and
thin-walled aluminum parts with unmatched speed, precision, and proven consistency. This advanced
method is ideal for high volume production with excellent dimensional control at a competitive
overall cost.
[Discover More][118]
[Vacuum Die Casting][119]
Vacuum die casting significantly enhances overall part integrity by reducing harmful gas porosity
during the casting process. We apply it to parts that require exceptional high strength, precision
machining, or strict porosity control, especially in sealing or safety-critical applications.
[Discover More][120]
[Semi-solid Die Casting][121]
We use semi-solid casting technology to improve flow control and reduce defects like porosity and
shrinkage. This process helps us deliver aluminum parts with higher precision, better strength, and
greater consistency. It is well suited for complex components in robotics and medical devices.
[Discover More][122]

## Custom Die Casting Parts For Your Industry

We provide die casting solutions that meet your industry’s needs, from functional parts to
appearance components, all built with quality and performance in mind.
Medical

Medical devices demand precise, lightweight, and strength parts for critical components. We produce
complex aluminum castings for surgical systems, imaging devices, and diagnostic equipment.

[Get a Quick Quote][123]
Marine

Marine equipment needs corrosion resistant and sealed parts to ensure long term performance
offshore. We produce aluminum housings and components for navigation, control, and onboard
electronics.

[Get a Quick Quote][124]
Automotive

Automotive parts must meet tight tolerances, structural strength, and cost efficiency. We offer
design flexibility and casting expertise to support volume production of brackets, housings, and
other structural components.

[Get a Quick Quote][125]
Robotics

From industrial arms to surgical robots, we supply aluminum components that combine strength,
precision, and lightweight performance, engineering for smooth motion and reliability.

[Get a Quick Quote][126]
Telecommunication

We cast aluminum enclosures, housings, and heatsinks for telecom systems. These components combine
structural strength and thermal stability for reliable performance in compact, high demand
environments.

[Get a Quick Quote][127]
Agriculture

We make durable aluminum housings and covers for agricultural electronics like positioning and
control units. Designed to resist shock, moisture, and outdoor exposure, our parts protect sensitive
systems in the field.

[Get a Quick Quote][128]

### Prototyping

Fast Verification
We machine parts directly from solid aluminum with no tooling required. This is ideal for fast
testing, fit checks, and design changes.
Broad Scope of Material
We offer prototypes in aluminum, zinc and stainless steel to match real application needs.
Multi-axis CNC Machinery
Our 3 axis to 5 axis CNC machines support tight tolerances and complex geometries.
[Talk to Us][129]
[Die Casting Tooling]

### Die Casting Tooling

Design Support
We provide mold flow analysis and DFM guidance to optimize casting quality and reduce trial cycles.
Fast Lead Time
Our molds are designed, built, and maintained in-house. First samples are typically delivered within
2 to 4 weeks.
Long Tool Life
We ensure stable production with hardened tool steel, proper processing, and complete lifetime mold
care.
[Talk to Us][130]
[Aluminum Die Casting]

### Aluminum Die Casting

Wide Tonnage Range
We cast aluminum parts from small housings to large enclosures using 280 to1600 ton die casting
machines.
Advanced Casting Process
We use vacuum and semi-solid technologies to reduce porosity and improve mechanical strength.
Reliable Batch Quality
Our process control ensures consistent dimensions and stable production quality.
[Talk to Us][131]
[CNC Machining]

### Machining

Tight Tolerance Capability
We achieve high accuracy on key dimensions, making it ideal for high precision assemblies.
Custom Fixtures & Tools
We design fixtures and cutting tools in-house to ensure stability and repeatability in every
operation.
Complex Geometry Ready
Our Makino precision CNC machines handle deep pockets, fine walls, and multi surface parts with high
accuracy.

### Surface Finishing

Full Treatment Capabilities
We offer sandblasting, surtec 650, powder coating, plating, and more.
Functional & Cosmetic Options
Our finishes meet both technical requirements such as corrosion resistance and visual standards for
appearance parts.
Consistent Quality
We ensure surface consistency with controlled processes and qualified local partners.
[Talk to Us][133]

## Where Precision Meets Poduction

We produce precision parts through advanced die casting, high end CNC machining, and tightly
controlled production processes.
* ### [ Precision Production][134]
  
  Every stage of our production, from mold design to CNC machining, is built for precision. With
  advanced die casting processes and Makino equipment, we achieve ±0.005 mm tolerances on critical
  features.
  Stable processes, skilled teams, and real-time inspections ensure dimensional consistency and
  reliable quality across batches.

## Sunrise Die Casting Technology

We use the right casting method based on your design and performance requirements, delivering high
precision, mechanical strength, and good performance parts for you.
[High Pressure Die Casting][117]
High pressure die casting is our primary core manufacturing focus. We produce complex and
thin-walled aluminum parts with unmatched speed, precision, and proven consistency. This advanced
method is ideal for high volume production with excellent dimensional control at a competitive
overall cost.
[Discover More][118]
[Vacuum Die Casting][119]
Vacuum die casting significantly enhances overall part integrity by reducing harmful gas porosity
during the casting process. We apply it to parts that require exceptional high strength, precision
machining, or strict porosity control, especially in sealing or safety-critical applications.
[Discover More][120]
[Semi-solid Die Casting][121]
We use semi-solid casting technology to improve flow control and reduce defects like porosity and
shrinkage. This process helps us deliver aluminum parts with higher precision, better strength, and
greater consistency. It is well suited for complex components in robotics and medical devices.
[Discover More][122]

## Custom Die Casting Parts For Your Industry

We provide die casting solutions that meet your industry’s needs, from functional parts to
appearance components, all built with quality and performance in mind.
Medical

Medical devices demand precise, lightweight, and strength parts for critical components. We produce
complex aluminum castings for surgical systems, imaging devices, and diagnostic equipment.

[Get a Quick Quote][123]
Marine

Marine equipment needs corrosion resistant and sealed parts to ensure long term performance
offshore. We produce aluminum housings and components for navigation, control, and onboard
electronics.

[Get a Quick Quote][124]
Automotive

Automotive parts must meet tight tolerances, structural strength, and cost efficiency. We offer
design flexibility and casting expertise to support volume production of brackets, housings, and
other structural components.

[Get a Quick Quote][125]
Robotics

From industrial arms to surgical robots, we supply aluminum components that combine strength,
precision, and lightweight performance, engineering for smooth motion and reliability.

[Get a Quick Quote][126]
Telecommunication

We cast aluminum enclosures, housings, and heatsinks for telecom systems. These components combine
structural strength and thermal stability for reliable performance in compact, high demand
environments.

[Get a Quick Quote][127]
Agriculture

We make durable aluminum housings and covers for agricultural electronics like positioning and
control units. Designed to resist shock, moisture, and outdoor exposure, our parts protect sensitive
systems in the field.

[Get a Quick Quote][128]

### Prototyping

Fast Verification
We machine parts directly from solid aluminum with no tooling required. This is ideal for fast
testing, fit checks, and design changes.
Broad Scope of Material
We offer prototypes in aluminum, zinc and stainless steel to match real application needs.
Multi-axis CNC Machinery
Our 3 axis to 5 axis CNC machines support tight tolerances and complex geometries.
[Talk to Us][129]

### Die Casting Tooling

Design Support
We provide mold flow analysis and DFM guidance to optimize casting quality and reduce trial cycles.
Fast Lead Time
Our molds are designed, built, and maintained in-house. First samples are typically delivered within
2 to 4 weeks.
Long Tool Life
We ensure stable production with hardened tool steel, proper processing, and complete lifetime mold
care.

[Aluminum Die Casting]

### Aluminum Die Casting

Wide Tonnage Range
We cast aluminum parts from small housings to large enclosures using 280 to1600 ton die casting
machines.
Advanced Casting Process
We use vacuum and semi-solid technologies to reduce porosity and improve mechanical strength.
Reliable Batch Quality
Our process control ensures consistent dimensions and stable production quality.

[CNC Machining]

### Machining

Tight Tolerance Capability
We achieve high accuracy on key dimensions, making it ideal for high precision assemblies.
Custom Fixtures & Tools
We design fixtures and cutting tools in-house to ensure stability and repeatability in every
operation.
Complex Geometry Ready
Our Makino precision CNC machines handle deep pockets, fine walls, and multi surface parts with high
accuracy.
[Talk to Us][132]
[Surface Finishing]

### Surface Finishing

Full Treatment Capabilities
We offer sandblasting, surtec 650, powder coating, plating, and more.
Functional & Cosmetic Options
Our finishes meet both technical requirements such as corrosion resistance and visual standards for
appearance parts.
Consistent Quality
We ensure surface consistency with controlled processes and qualified local partners.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Do you have experience serving Western clients?

Yes! Over the past 15 years, we have established long-term partnerships with more than 100 clients
in the United States, the European Union, Canada, and Australia, covering all industries.

How do you handle shipping to the US/EU? What incoterms do you support?

We work with DHL, FedEx, UPS, and sea freight forwarders (for bulk orders) with discounted rates.

Incoterms: EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP (door-to-door, including customs clearance and taxes—popular for EU/US
clients).

What quality control measures do you have in place?

Our QC process follows ISO 9001 standards, with 3 key checkpoints:
* **Incoming Material Inspection:** Verify material certificates (e.g., from Baosteel, Alcoa) and
  test hardness/thickness.
* **In-Process Inspection:** Sampling every 2 hours for stamping/bending/CNC; use coordinate
  measuring machines (CMM) for precision parts.
* **Final Inspection:** 100% check for critical dimensions; provide a detailed inspection report
  with each shipment.

Defective parts are reworked or replaced free of charge.

What factors affect your pricing? How can I get an accurate quote?

Pricing depends on: material type, part complexity, tolerance, order quantity, and surface finish.
To get a precise quote, please provide:
* 2D/3D drawings (STEP/IGS preferred)
* Material specification (e.g., 304 stainless steel, 1.5mm thick)
* Quantity (prototype vs. mass production)
* Surface finish (e.g., powder coat RAL 9005)

We’ll send a detailed quote within 12 business hours.

How do you protect my design and intellectual property (IP)?

We take IP protection seriously and offer 2 layers of security:
* Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA): We sign mutual NDAs before receiving your drawings/samples.
* Internal Controls: All client files are stored on password-protected servers; only authorized
  engineers have access. We delete all files after production is complete.

We have never had an IP infringement case in 15 years of serving Western clients.

Can you assist with design optimization to reduce costs?

Absolutely. Our engineers will review your design and suggest changes like:
* Simplifying stamping die structures to cut tooling costs.
* Using standard sheet sizes for laser cutting to minimize waste.
* Optimizing CNC tool paths to reduce machining time.

These changes can lower costs by 20-30% without compromising quality.

* Internal Controls: All client files are stored on password-protected servers; only authorized
  engineers have access. We delete all files after production is complete.

We have never had an IP infringement case in 15 years of serving Western clients.

Can you assist with design optimization to reduce costs?

Absolutely. Our engineers will review your design and suggest changes like:
* Simplifying stamping die structures to cut tooling costs.
* Using standard sheet sizes for laser cutting to minimize waste.
* Optimizing CNC tool paths to reduce machining time.

These changes can lower costs by 20-30% without compromising quality.

High-volume production stampings (50,000+ parts/year) and fabricated aluminum extrusions — with
secondary operations and assembly under one roof.

We help OEMs simplify their supply chain by producing finished stamped and extruded components, not
just parts that still need work.

## Built for High-Volume, Long-Term Programs

Talan Products specializes in progressive die metal stamping for repeat production programs where
consistency, quality, and scale matter. For customers that also require aluminum components, we
fabricate aluminum extrusions with precision secondary operations, allowing you to reduce vendors,
lead times, and total cost.

We’re not a job shop — we’re a high-volume manufacturing partner.

** 30 ** + Years Of Experience

Many suppliers stop at stamping or extrusion. We don’t. Talan Products is built around doing the
next step — the fabrication and assembly work that turns parts into ready-to-use components.

## High-Volume Stamping, Aluminum Fabrication & Assembly Solutions

Progressive Die Metal Stamping (Our Core)
We specialize in progressive die metal stamping for OEMs that require:
* High-volume, repeatable production
* Tight tolerances and long-term consistency
* High-volume, repeatable production
* High-volume, repeatable production

Our engineering team works closely with customers on DFM and early supplier involvement, helping
ensure your part is designed for manufacturability before tooling is built.

Fabricated Aluminum Extrusions (More Than Mill Supply)

* Evenly spaced or complex hole patterns
* Precision cut-to-length profiles
* Secondary machining and tapping
* Assembly into finished components

Whether your program ships by the pallet or by the truckload, we support high-volume aluminum
extrusion fabrication with the same production mindset as our stamping operations.

From the microchips powering AI to the infrastructure that moves data, TRUMPF technologies help
build the foundation of modern progress.

EUV, laser and plasma solutions for state-of-the-art microprocessors and AI chips.

[Find out more][198]

### [Automotive Deep Draw Stamping][85]

The automotive industry runs on precision. Every component within a vehicle must perform reliably
under extreme conditions, meet strict dimensional standards, and hold up across thousands of hours
of use.

[Read More About Automotive Deep Draw Stamping][86]
[
[Transfer Press Stamping Company][Transfer Press Stamping Company]
][87]

### [Transfer Press Stamping FAQ][88]

Manufacturers that need durable, repeatable, and cost-effective components often turn to transfer
press stamping for high-volume production. This metal forming process is widely used to create
complex custom metal stamped parts with tight tolerances and consistent quality.

[Read More About Transfer Press Stamping FAQ][89]
[
[Deep Draw Metal Forming Company][Deep Draw Metal Forming Company]
][90]

### [Elements to Consider When Designing for Deep Drawing][91]

Designing successful deep drawn metal parts starts long before a press ever cycles. Companies across
industries, from the automotive giants to those focused on alternative energy, rely on this trusted
process to produce durable, high-precision components. As a global metal stamping manufacturer, we
know that getting the design right means understanding how material, geometry, and process variables
all interact.

[Read More About Elements to Consider When Designing for Deep Drawing][92]

### [Automotive Deep Draw Stamping][85]

The automotive industry runs on precision. Every component within a vehicle must perform reliably
under extreme conditions, meet strict dimensional standards, and hold up across thousands of hours
of use.

[Read More About Automotive Deep Draw Stamping][86]
[
[Transfer Press Stamping Company][Transfer Press Stamping Company]
][87]

### [Transfer Press Stamping FAQ][88]

Manufacturers that need durable, repeatable, and cost-effective components often turn to transfer
press stamping for high-volume production. This metal forming process is widely used to create
complex custom metal stamped parts with tight tolerances and consistent quality.

[Read More About Transfer Press Stamping FAQ][89]
[
[Deep Draw Metal Forming Company][Deep Draw Metal Forming Company]
][90]

### [Elements to Consider When Designing for Deep Drawing][91]

Designing successful deep drawn metal parts starts long before a press ever cycles. Companies across
industries, from the automotive giants to those focused on alternative energy, rely on this trusted
process to produce durable, high-precision components. As a global metal stamping manufacturer, we
know that getting the design right means understanding how material, geometry, and process variables
all interact.

[Read More About Elements to Consider When Designing for Deep Drawing][92]

# Precision Metals Solutions for Your Most Challenging Applications

Ulbrich delivers custom-engineered strip, foil, and precision wire for critical applications across
aerospace, medical, automotive, industrial, and other demanding markets. With tight tolerances,
reliable supply, and metallurgical support, we help manufacturers reduce risk, improve performance,
and build with confidence.

[

#### Strip & Foil

Re-roller and distributor of over 100 alloys of precision strip and foil including stainless steel,
titanium, nickel alloy and cobalt alloy.

View Product
][200] [

#### Shaped Wire

Shaped Wire is produced to exacting cross-sectional dimensions in our dedicated shaped wire
facility. Shaped profile wire minimizes or eliminates costly machining by being net, or near net, in
shape.

View Product
][201] [

#### Fine & Flat Wire

Custom engineered precision wire products including; Fine Wire, Round Wire, Flat Wire, and Shaped
Profiles.

View Product
][202]

### Ulbrich Material for Any Situation

[View All Alloys][203]

#### [Stainless Steel][204]

Ulbrich can offer Stainless Steel in a variety of chemical and mechanical properties to enhance your
product.
* Austenitic
* Martensitic
* Ferritic
* PH Grades
* Additional options

#### [Nickel][205]

Ulbrich’s Nickel Alloys can be used for highly corrosive or high-temperature environments.
* HASTELLOY®
* INCOLOY
* INCONEL®
* MONEL®
* Additional options

#### [Titanium][206]

Ulbrich’s Titanium Alloys are lightweight, corrosion resistant and able to withstand extreme
temperatures.
* Titanium Grade 1
* Titanium Grade 2
* Titanium Grade 9
* TI 15-3-3-3
* Additional options

#### [Cobalt][207]

Ulbrich’s resilient Cobalt Alloys are typically used for jet engines, turbines, and dental implants.
* MP35N®
* WASPALOY®
* L605®
* Additional options

#### [Bi-Metals][208]

Ulbrich provides copper-clad Bi-Metal material for RF cable, aerospace, satellite, and electronic
applications.
* Silver Plated Copper Clad Aluminum (SPCCA)
* Silver Plated Copper Clad Steel (SPCCS)
* Additional options

## Inside the Engine

URLert is an orchestrated system of specialized AI agents.

### Domain Intelligence

Before scanning content, we analyze the domain. We check for **Typosquatting** (e.g., `paypa1.com`),
domain age, and high-risk TLDs to catch attacks before they even load.

Typosquat Detection Newly Registered Domain

### The Orchestrator

Our "Fail-Fast" engine. If the domain is obviously malicious, we stop there. If it's suspicious, we
trigger deeper scans. It intelligently routes the URL to optimize speed and cost.

Context-Aware Smart Routing

### Static & Cloaking Analysis

We simulate multiple visitors (Mobile Device, Desktop, GoogleBot) simultaneously. This forces
"Cloaking" attacks to reveal their true payloads targeting mobile victims.

Anti-Cloaking User-Agent Variance

### Visual & Behavioral

For high-stakes URLs, we launch a headless browser. We use **Computer Vision** to "see" the page
like a human, detecting fake login forms and drive-by downloads that code analysis misses.

Brand Logo Match Fake Login Detection

### The AI SOC Analyst

Finally, our LLM Synthesizer reviews all findings. It acts as a Senior Security Analyst, ignoring
noise and writing a human-readable explanation of *why* the site is dangerous.

Everything you need to know about checking suspicious URLs and staying safe online.

How do I check if a link from a text or email is a scam?
Simply copy the link and paste it into the search bar above. **Do not click the link first.** URLert
uses an AI-powered investigation engine to "visit" the site for you in a secure environment. We
analyze the page layout, check for hidden redirects, and look for signs of brand impersonation (like
a fake bank login) so you don't have to risk your own device.
Why is URLert better than Google or VirusTotal for new links?
Traditional scanners rely on "blacklists"—which means they only catch a scam *after* people have
already been hurt. **URLert is built for zero-day threats.** Our AI acts like a human analyst: it
takes a real-time screenshot and reads the code of the site the second you scan it. This allows us
to detect brand-new scams and phishing pages hours or even days before the big databases catch up.
What does "Zero-Day Phishing" mean?
A "zero-day" attack is a brand-new scam created today that no one has seen yet. Scammers often
register new domains (like `yourbank-secure-login.top`) and send out thousands of texts before
Google or Microsoft can flag them. URLert's AI looks at the domain age, registration details (RDAP),
and visual cues to identify these "infant" threats instantly.
Can I safely scan shortened links (like bit.ly or t.co)?
Yes. Shortened links are the #1 way scammers hide their tracks. When you paste a shortened URL into
URLert, our engine follows the "breadcrumb trail" through every redirect until it finds the final
destination. We scan that final page to ensure it's not a cloaked attack designed to steal your
credentials.

## Inside the Engine

### Domain Intelligence

a fake bank login) so you don't have to risk your own device.
Why is URLert better than Google or VirusTotal for new links?

fasteners and parts. The cornerstone of our business is our signature line of Valco snap button

fasteners. Valco works closely with customers to develop new models to fit specialized product

quality. We look forward to assisting you with advice and providing you with premium components.

### Stamping

### Tube & Rod Bending

designs and develops a wide array of tubular and solid hangers and pressure pipes for Exhaust system
applications as per the requirements of our global clientele.

[Forging]

### Forging

The advance set up at the forging division has screw and hammer forging presses for open and closed
die forgings ranging up to 2000 tons with induction heating facility and automated processes for
billet loading, auto greasing and material transfer.

[Machining]

### Machining

processes to manufacture precision CNC machining parts using Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel,
Stainless Steel with hard chrome and Aluminum with hard and soft anodizing.

### Aluminum Casting

Victura has an advanced setup for manufacturing an array of Aluminum cast components using pressure
die casting & gravity die casting techniques. The foundry is equipped with Skelner furnaces with
capacity of melting 2000 kgs of aluminum alloys per hour for alloy making.

die forgings ranging up to 2000 tons with induction heating facility and automated processes for

[Machining]

processes to manufacture precision CNC machining parts using Carbon Steel, Stainless Steel,
Stainless Steel with hard chrome and Aluminum with hard and soft anodizing.

### Aluminum Casting

Victura has an advanced setup for manufacturing an array of Aluminum cast components using pressure
die casting & gravity die casting techniques. The foundry is equipped with Skelner furnaces with
capacity of melting 2000 kgs of aluminum alloys per hour for alloy making.

### Investment Casting

Our modern precision Investment casting division is a hallmark of our production capabilities
meeting international standards. The division delivers premier quality investment castings at
shortest lead times.

in DaLang Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, China.

engaged in precision machinery parts processing, fixture design development and production, radiator
design development and production.

riveting, assembly, etc. The products are related to industry of medical, communication, Automarket,

precision casting and stamping processing, and complete your entrustment.

## about us

About factory description

#### what we do

Dongguan Voerly Machinery Technology Co., Ltd. (Dongguan Sixin Factory) was established in July,1996
in DaLang Town, Dongguan City, Guangdong Province, China.
It near Songshan Lake Area with convenient transportation. It is a comprehensive high-tech company
engaged in precision machinery parts processing, fixture design development and production, radiator
design development and production.
The main production processes include CNC precision machining, CNC lathe machining, stamping,
riveting, assembly, etc. The products are related to industry of medical, communication, Automarket,
military, connector, radiator module and other fields.
With the high-quality service and good reputation, Voerly is developing steadily in the CNC
precision processing industry, not only in the non-standard parts processing, but also in precision
component processing, radiator product processing, precision fixture processing. The company has
made great progress and provided value-added services for customers to complete one-stop shopping
[more>>][51]

## Quality assurance

We always adhere to the principle of providing customers with the best quality products on the basis
of reasonable price. We control the product quality by combining "prevention" and "inspection",
provide safe and reliable quality control technology for production, escort CNC precision machining,
precision casting and stamping processing, and complete your entrustment.

## Custom Capabilities

##### Deep Drawn Metal Stampings

For deep drawn parts, we use our transfer presses to efficiently draw stainless, aluminum, brass and
copper alloys into cup, dish and can shaped parts.

[
More Details
][23]

##### Progressive Die Metal Stampings

Serving customers globally, Volkert Precision Technologies is a leader in progressive die stamping.
We build our own tooling in house and can take over customer-owned tools for future production.

[
More Details
][24]

##### Assembly and Value-Added Services

Capabilities include stamped assemblies, finishing, heat treating, kitting and other secondary
operations. We also have a complete line of Belleville washers.

[
More Details

##### Multi-Slide & Fourslide Metal Stampings

We are experts in micro and ultra-miniature stampings with extremely tight tolerances from precious
metals, such as silver, palladium, consil, Paliney® and ELKONIUM®.

## Satisfaction

What started as Volkert -- a tool and die shop -- has evolved into a diverse group of metalforming
capabilities, driven by "Customer Satisfaction Through Continual Improvement" as a Quality Policy.

[
Read About Volkert
][34]
[Factory workers checking quality products large industrial hall 1]
We specialize in providing quality products produced on time and under budget.
[
View Our Products
][35]

**Volkert** Precision Technologies, Inc.

Is an **ISO 9001:2015 Certified by NQA manufacturer** of precision metal stampings with medium to
high volume production run capabilities. Stamped products include Multi-Slide® and Fourslide
components, Progressive Die Stampings and Deep Drawn Parts in materials including aluminum,
stainless steel, brass, copper and a variety of exotic alloys.

In-house services include design, EDM wire tooling and bar coding. Other production services
include, but are not limited to, soft soldering, silver brazing, TIG welding, arc welding, heat
treating and plating along with precision sheet metal fabrication and mechanical assembly. Specialty
metals included.

Total Quality Commitment - ISO 9001:2015 Certified by NQA. Our policy of “Customer Satisfaction
Through Continual Improvement" means our goal is achieving 100% acceptance of every part we ship to
every customer.

View Full Quality Assurance

# Build Your Dream with Walker Manufacturing

[ VISION & MISSION ][47]

Over 70 Years of Dedication & Success in the Industry

Walker Manufacturing Group not only provides defect-free parts and on-demand metal forming services,
but is also deeply committed to environmental leadership and lean manufacturing, ensuring customer
satisfaction, optimal consistency, and quality while minimizing waste and raw material costs.

## Perfecting the Art of Metal Forming for More Than Seven Decades

Decades With more than 260 manufacturing experts, 255,000 square feet of manufacturing space and
advanced understanding of cutting-edge, efficiency-enhancing concepts,
Walker Manufacturing Group is able to offer on-demand service, defect-free parts and unparalleled
timeliness.

[
[Close-up of a worker in heavy-duty gloves using a fabrication tool on a metal beam, creating a
bright shower of orange sparks.][Close-up of a worker in heavy-duty gloves using a fabrication tool
on a metal beam, creating a bright shower of orange sparks.]

## **FABRICATION**

Walker Manufacturing Group offers comprehensive, worry-free fabrication services with unparalleled
value-added services.

][48] [
[A massive beige Stamtec industrial stamping press machine stretching up to the ceiling inside a
large warehouse facility, surrounded by material racks and metal bins.][A massive beige Stamtec
industrial stamping press machine stretching up to the ceiling inside a large warehouse facility,
surrounded by material racks and metal bins.]

## **METAL STAMPING**

From simple stamped parts to complex automotive stamping, we have the knowledge and tools to fulfill
for you.

][49] [
[A close-up view of an industrial roll-forming machine with heavy metal rollers shaping a sheet of
metal under cool blue lighting.][A close-up view of an industrial roll-forming machine with heavy
metal rollers shaping a sheet of metal under cool blue lighting.]

## **ROLL FORMING**

We provide roll forming, efficiently shaping metal sheets into custom profiled components for
various industries.

][50] [
[A collection of various coiled constant-force springs in brass and metallic finishes, displayed in
different sizes and configurations on a light grey background.][A collection of various coiled
constant-force springs in brass and metallic finishes, displayed in different sizes and
configurations on a light grey background.]

## **CONSTANT FORCE SPRINGS**

We’ve been providing constant force springs to consumer, medical and aerospace customers for over 30
years.

][51] [
[a large yellow industrial tool working with sheet metal][a large yellow industrial tool working
with sheet metal]

## **TOOLING**

Our tooling specialists use decades of experience to provide comprehensive tool design, production
and repair.

][52]
[An engineer or designer wearing glasses sits at a desk, using a computer monitor to view a complex
3D CAD wireframe model of a mechanical part or industrial tool.][An engineer or designer wearing
glasses sits at a desk, using a computer monitor to view a complex 3D CAD wireframe model of a
mechanical part or industrial tool.]

## **PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT**

Our product development assets ensures every customer gets efficiently manufactured, timely and
cost-effective parts.

Sustainability

An Environmentally Responsible Corporate Citizen

From strategic planning to daily operations, we’re committed to being a good corporate citizen.

[ GET IN TOUCH ][53]

We Follow Sustainability Best Practic

## Complete Prototyping & Manufacturing Capabilities

As a one-stop rapid manufacturing and prototyping company for your team, let’s watch the video to

Customized for You

## Focused on Rapid Prototyping and On-Demand Manufacturing Services

At WayKen, we provide one-stop rapid prototyping services and cost-effective rapid manufacturing
services to support every process of your product development and help you get to market faster.
Need only 1 or more than 10,000 units? Production-grade materials? Complex geometric shapes? Tight
tolerances? Fine details? WayKen will always do our best to meet your design and machining needs.
Our company’s mission is to help your ideas come to life.

### CNC Machining

CNC machining is an optimal solution for custom machined prototypes & production parts, meeting your
strict specifications such as precise tolerances, special materials, complex parts and best
efficiency.
[ Learn More ][139]

### CNC Aluminum

Advanced 3 & 5-axis CNC milling, turning combined with auxiliary processes EDM and wire EDM, as well
as typical aluminum surface finishing, can achieve the most efficiently precise CNC aluminum
machining process.
[ Learn More ][140]

### Vacuum Casting

Vacuum casting (or urethane casting) is a quick way to make a small series of functional plastic
prototypes, providing end-use, rigid, flexible, and rubber parts at low cost and production-grade
quality.
[ Learn More ][141]

### Rapid Tooling

Rapid injection molding will be able to bridge the gap between prototype and production, creating
aluminum & steel rapid molds and low-volume injection molding to achieve lower tooling costs and
faster production changeovers.
[ Learn More ][142]

* ISO 9001:2015 certified prototype supplier to ensure that your project meets strict quality

* One-to-one support service by a technical team, quick response within a few hours.
* Most competitive prices in the market, 30% lower than Europe and America.
* Comprehensive capabilities include in-house machining and integration of manufacturing resources
  across China.
* An experienced team of engineers and flexible production methods mean faster manufacturing and

Product Development Process

## Prototype Your Ideas Before Manufacturing

As a professional prototype manufacturer, WayKen has the ability to deliver the finest visual design
models, full-functional engineering prototypes, or short-run and low-volume manufacturing services,
allowing you to verify your design thoroughly, and help you focus on the key elements of product
development.

[][144]

[Concept][145]

Create your Proof-of-Concept prototype and turn your ideas into reality. It’s important to keep the
conceptualization process moving and ideas flowing along the product design process.

[][146]

[Presentation][147]

Show a presentation model that's nearly identical to the real product to focus groups, trade shows,
or marketing activities. They can see it, hold it, and examine it from every angle.

[][148]

[Functional][149]

Functional prototypes can prove and perfect your design in rigorous test scenarios, by the
evaluation on materials, properties, tolerances, form fit & function, and working mechanisms.

[][150]

[Engineering][151]

Build up engineering prototypes to ensure products that are designed for manufacturing, and tested
for functionality, manufacturability, and viability through a series of validation phases.

[][152]

[Low-Volume][153]

Low-volume manufacturing allows you to move smoothly from prototype to production, promotes design
iterations more flexible, reduces risk, and saves production costs and time to market.

One-Stop Supplier

low-volume (HMLV) production. Our custom machine shop specializes in producing complex and precision
parts and components at any volume. Focus on offering on-demand production services, WayKen’s team
is always ready to respond swiftly to your needs, ensuring your machining projects are both
efficient and affordable.
