### [ Can you handle the entire metal stamping process?][48]

Yes. Wedge Products provides [complete metal stamping solutions][49], including engineering support,
tooling development, production stamping, and quality control.

Our team manufactures components for [industrial][50], [aerospace][51], and military applications
using progressive dies and specialized tooling designed for [long-run production][52].

### [What industries do you serve?][53]

Wedge Products manufactures precision metal stampings for a wide range of industrial and OEM
applications. We support manufacturers across industries including [automotive][54], [HVAC][55],
[industrial equipment][56], [agriculture][57], and [aerospace][58].

While we are aerospace certified, much of our work supports industrial manufacturing and
[high-volume OEM production][59] requiring reliable stamped metal components.

### [Do you work with OEM manufacturers?][60]

Yes. Wedge Products works directly with [OEM manufacturers][61] and production programs that require
dependable suppliers for stamped metal components.

Our team can manufacture precision [progressive metal stampings][62], assist with tooling
development, and support consistent production across long manufacturing runs.

### [What production volumes do you typically support?][63]

Our facility is designed for [medium-to-high volume metal stamping production][64], especially
projects that benefit from progressive die tooling and repeatable manufacturing processes.

Many customers come to Wedge when they need a metal stamping manufacturer capable of long production
runs, rather than short prototypes or low-volume work.

### [Do you handle long-run or high-volume metal stamping production?][65]

Yes. Wedge Products specializes in [long-run progressive stamping][66] and high-volume production
for OEM manufacturers and industrial companies. Using advanced tooling and progressive dies, we
produce consistent, precision metal stampings at scale.

Whether you need progressive stamping for [aluminum][67], [brass][68], or other materials, our team
can support large production runs while maintaining tight tolerances and reliable lead times.

### [Where are you located?][69]

Wedge Products is based in Cleveland, Ohio, serving manufacturers throughout the United States.

In today’s fast paced environment for product manufacturers you need reliable suppliers in your
region of the country. You need [metal stampings][44], [fabrications][45], [weldments and
sub-assemblies][46] for your products. And you need them… when you need them!!! On-time and of the
highest quality with the right finishes.

That’s where Wrico Stamping Company can help! With [6 strategically located U.S. facilities][47]
Wrico serves the entire country with regionalized support for your [metal stamping][48], [precision
fabricating][49], [welding and assembly][50] needs. If you need help with your parts send one of our
facilities an [RFQ][51] or check out our [Design Guides For Metal Stampings & Fabrications][52].

Whether it’s a new design you’re working on, a redesign of an existing product or a part that needs
cost improvement Wrico can help. Our engineers scrutinize every detail of your design, from concept
and trouble-shooting through pre-production to full production. Wrico assures you’ll benefit from
our optimized manufacturing and cost efficiencies.

[

### Wrico… we’re everywhere you need us.

][53]
[[Metal Stamping]][54][

##### Metal Stamping

][55]

With over 200 Presses throughout Wrico facilities, we can assure your [metal stampings][56] are a
perfect fit. Our capabilities handle the full range of [metal stampings][57] from prototype, short,
medium and long runs.

[LEARN MORE][58]
[[Fabrication]][59][

##### Precision Fabrication

][60]

Flexible and fast-turnaround of your parts is expertly handled by Wrico. Our full array of 2D and 3D
lasers, CNC turret presses, and press brakes simplify tooling needs and provide for easy part design
changes.

[LEARN MORE][61]
[[Assembly and More]][62][

##### Assembly & More

][63]

Adding value beyond the sheet metal part. Wrico expertly handles the needs of pem setting, staking,
hardware insertion and welding. We produce small to medium sized assemblies complete with finishing
and JIT delivery for a wide variety of industry needs.

[LEARN MORE][64]
With over 423,500 square feet of capacity and more than 600 employees, Wrico’s 6 U.S. facilities are
capable of serving your needs. [**Get an RFQ today!**][65]

fabricating][49], [welding and assembly][50] needs. If you need help with your parts send one of our

our optimized manufacturing and cost efficiencies.

## Custom Metal Stamping Service

Xinsanxin Precision is an expert in producing custom metal stamping parts created to your specs as
well as providing design expertise that helps you get a custom component in the most time- and
cost-effective manner. We have multiple manufacturing facilities that stock various standard and
specialty materials and perform multiple forms of metal stamping for a variety of industries and
applications.
In-house tooling and design capabilities, engineering support, and a wide array of secondary
processes (deburring, e-coat, welding, assembly, etc.) allow MW to manufacture even the most complex
metal stamping designs for your applications.

### Xiamen Xinsanxin Precision Machinery Co.,Ltd

Established in 2001, Xiamen Xinsanxin Precision Machinery Co., Ltd has been the leading manufacturer
of automotive accessories & custom metal stamping parts for over 20 years. We supply different kinds
of automotive accessories, including car seat brackets, clamps, pipe clips for different vehicle
manufacturer like BMW, Hyundai etc.
Our facilities leverage various presses from 30 to 400-ton capacity to produce a wide range of
custom metal stamping parts. The metallurgical expertise we use to design our spring and fastener
products also extends to stampings, allowing our engineers to create components utilizing materials
from low-carbon steel to pre-tempered alloys in thicknesses from .004″ to .312″ depending on the
configuration of the part and tonnage required.
[ More About Us ][32]

## Provides our customers one-stop service in metal products design and manufacturing.

Our highly experienced and skilled design and production team has enable us to earn ISO 9001 and
IATF 16949 certificates. With our own mold design team, parts procurement team and assembly team, we
can not only customize parts according to the drawings, but also help customers to do assembly.

## Custom Metal Stamping Service

Xinsanxin Precision is an expert in producing custom metal stamping parts created to your specs as
well as providing design expertise that helps you get a custom component in the most time- and
cost-effective manner. We have multiple manufacturing facilities that stock various standard and
specialty materials and perform multiple forms of metal stamping for a variety of industries and
applications.
In-house tooling and design capabilities, engineering support, and a wide array of secondary
processes (deburring, e-coat, welding, assembly, etc.) allow MW to manufacture even the most complex
metal stamping designs for your applications.

### Xiamen Xinsanxin Precision Machinery Co.,Ltd

Established in 2001, Xiamen Xinsanxin Precision Machinery Co., Ltd has been the leading manufacturer
of automotive accessories & custom metal stamping parts for over 20 years. We supply different kinds
of automotive accessories, including car seat brackets, clamps, pipe clips for different vehicle
manufacturer like BMW, Hyundai etc.
Our facilities leverage various presses from 30 to 400-ton capacity to produce a wide range of
custom metal stamping parts. The metallurgical expertise we use to design our spring and fastener
products also extends to stampings, allowing our engineers to create components utilizing materials
from low-carbon steel to pre-tempered alloys in thicknesses from .004″ to .312″ depending on the
configuration of the part and tonnage required.

## Provides our customers one-stop service in metal products design and manufacturing.

Our highly experienced and skilled design and production team has enable us to earn ISO 9001 and
IATF 16949 certificates. With our own mold design team, parts procurement team and assembly team, we
can not only customize parts according to the drawings, but also help customers to do assembly.

With diverse in-house manufacturing processes operated within our own facilities, we bring

In-House Manufacturing Capabilities

## Diverse Manufacturing Processes. One Accountable Team.

Common Challenges

Are you missing opportunities to reduce cost simply because no one is looking at your design and
process together?

Have you ever been forced to redesign a part just because your supplier could only support one
process?

Have you experienced delays or quality issues because responsibilities were split across multiple
vendors?

Do complex parts involving multiple materials or processes become difficult to coordinate, optimize,
and control?

How We Help

We operate multiple manufacturing processes within our own facilities, keeping sourcing,
engineering, and production aligned from prototyping to low-volume runs and full-scale production.

You don’t need to manage multiple suppliers or have in-depth knowledge of how different processes
should work together. Our engineering and production teams optimize your part through the right
combination of manufacturing methods, reducing cost, ensuring smooth transitions between processes,
and maintaining consistent quality throughout.

# Maximize Manufacturing.

Catalyze the world's ideas into products.

[Learn More][27]
WHO WE ARE

## Make for India, Make for the World

As a technology-led, asset-light manufacturing platform, we deliver diversified industrial products
across sectors including utilities, renewables, consumer electronics, AI infrastructure, space &
defence, oil & gas, and industrial automation and aerospace both in India and globally.

Our manufacturing platform served 1,100+ customers across 17 countries, through 5,300+ third-party
suppliers across 23 countries and 20+ owned manufacturing facilities across four countries.

Our flexible, tech-enabled model orchestrates global supply chains to accelerate time-to-market and
ensure quality at any scale. From design to logistics, we offer a "one-stop shop" for customers
looking to purchase multiple products across categories.

Serving everyone from startups to 98 of India’s Fortune 500 companies, we simplify the manufacturing
lifecycle through a single, transparent platform that optimizes underutilized global capacity.

# Maximize Manufacturing.

Catalyze the world's ideas into products.

[Learn More][27]
WHO WE ARE

## Make for India, Make for the World

As a technology-led, asset-light manufacturing platform, we deliver diversified industrial products
across sectors including utilities, renewables, consumer electronics, AI infrastructure, space &
defence, oil & gas, and industrial automation and aerospace both in India and globally.

Our manufacturing platform served 1,100+ customers across 17 countries, through 5,300+ third-party
suppliers across 23 countries and 20+ owned manufacturing facilities across four countries.

Our flexible, tech-enabled model orchestrates global supply chains to accelerate time-to-market and
ensure quality at any scale. From design to logistics, we offer a "one-stop shop" for customers
looking to purchase multiple products across categories.

Serving everyone from startups to 98 of India’s Fortune 500 companies, we simplify the manufacturing
lifecycle through a single, transparent platform that optimizes underutilized global capacity.
